zh.name: 小米 Xiaomi
idea: 小米这个名字，雷军讲过来历：佛家有句话叫“一粒米如须弥山”。一粒米很小，可里面装得下一座山。一家公司也一样，从一粒米开始，也能长成一座山。
2021 年，原研哉给小米换了新 logo，把方角改成更圆润的超椭圆，提的概念叫 Alive，就是让 logo 像有生命一样。我们就顺着这个词，让它真的活一回。
beats: 橙色的 logo 先缩小，缩成一粒米
米粒开始分裂、往外喷，越来越多，堆成一座米山
米山慢慢站起来，重新长回 logo 的形状
多出来的米粒四散跳走，留出中间白色的 MI
zh.summary: 从一粒米到一座山，最后又回到那一粒。小和大从来不是两回事，一家公司最初的样子，就藏在它今天的样子里。

en.name: Xiaomi
idea: Lei Jun has explained where the name Xiaomi ("millet", literally "little rice") comes from. There is a Buddhist saying: "A single grain of rice is like Mount Sumeru," the vast mountain at the center of the Buddhist universe. A grain of rice is tiny, yet a whole mountain fits inside it. A company works the same way. It can start as one grain and grow into a mountain.

In 2021, Kenya Hara gave Xiaomi a new logo. He swapped the square corners for a softer superellipse and called the concept Alive: a logo that feels like a living thing. We took that word at face value and let the logo come alive for real.
beats: The orange logo shrinks down until it is a single grain of rice
The grain starts to split and spray outward, more and more, until the grains pile up into a mountain of rice
The mountain slowly stands up and grows back into the shape of the logo
The leftover grains hop away in every direction, leaving the white MI in the middle
en.summary: From one grain to a mountain, and back to that one grain. Small and big were always the same thing. What a company looked like at the start is hidden inside what it looks like today.

zh.name: 星巴克 Starbucks
idea: 星巴克绿色圆标里的那位双尾海妖，原型来自一幅 16 世纪的北欧木刻；Starbucks 这个名字，来自小说《白鲸记》里捕鲸船上的大副 Starbuck。第一家店开在西雅图的海港边，这个牌子从出生起就带着海风。
传说海妖会用歌声把水手引过去。咖啡香也是这样：你在街上走着，闻到味道，就拐进了店里。所以这次用北欧木刻的刀痕来做，把圆标当成船上看海的一扇圆窗，让海妖回一趟她的海。
beats: 圆标变成一扇圆窗，窗外是木刻的海
海妖一头扎进海里，一艘帆船从窗前驶过
星光在海面上铺出一条路，像在给船指方向
海妖再从海里升起，退下去的浪，正好变回她身体两侧的尾巴条纹
zh.summary: logo 不只是一张图，它是一段航海故事的最后一帧。海妖回了一趟海，又回到杯子上，等着下一个被香味引来的人。

en.name: Starbucks
en.film: The Siren Goes Back to Sea
idea: The twin-tailed siren in the green Starbucks circle is based on a 16th-century Norse woodcut. The name Starbucks comes from Starbuck, first mate of the whaling ship in Moby-Dick. The first store opened by the harbor in Seattle. This brand has carried a sea breeze since the day it was born.

Legend says sirens lured sailors in with their song. Coffee does the same thing. You are walking down the street, you catch the smell, and you turn into the shop. So we built this one with the knife marks of a Norse woodcut. The round logo becomes a ship's porthole looking out at the sea, and the siren gets one trip back to her ocean.
beats: The round logo turns into a porthole, with a woodcut sea outside
The siren dives headfirst into the sea, and a sailing ship glides past the window
Starlight lays a path across the water, as if showing the ship the way
The siren rises out of the sea again, and the retreating waves become the tail stripes on either side of her body
en.summary: A logo can be the last frame of a sea story. The siren went home to the ocean for a moment, then came back to the cup to wait for the next person the smell draws in.

zh.name: 乐高 LEGO
zh.film: 六块积木 九亿种玩法
idea: 把乐高方标拆成 6 块 2×4 积木，用拼装说明书的版式来演，步骤号一路往上涨。
乐高 1932 年在丹麦靠做木头玩具起家，一只能拉着走的木鸭子是早年的招牌，所以第一个拼出来的就是鸭子。
为什么是 6 块？乐高官方算过：6 块同色的 2×4 积木，一共有 915,103,765 种拼法。LEGO 这个名字来自丹麦语 leg godt，意思是“好好玩”。6 块积木就有九亿多种玩法，这是对“好好玩”最直接的证明。
beats: 方标先拆开，变成 6 块红色的 2×4 积木
积木依次拼成鸭子、塔、楼梯、桥，每一块都按凸点咬合，和我们小时候拼乐高一模一样
画面一角的步骤号一路往上跳，最后停在 915,103,765
积木全部归位，拼回方标，凸点上压着 LEGO
zh.summary: 最后那块方标不是终点，只是九亿多种可能里的其中一种。下一秒，它随时可以拆开重新拼。

en.name: LEGO
en.film: Six Bricks, 900 Million Ways to Play
idea: We broke the square LEGO logo into six 2×4 bricks and staged it like a building-instructions booklet, with the step number climbing all the way.
LEGO started in Denmark in 1932 making wooden toys. A wooden pull-along duck was one of its early signature pieces, so the first thing the bricks build is a duck.

Why six bricks? LEGO did the math itself: six 2×4 bricks of the same color can be combined in 915,103,765 ways. The name LEGO comes from the Danish leg godt, "play well". Six bricks, more than 900 million ways to play. That is the plainest proof of "play well" we could find.
beats: The square logo comes apart into six red 2×4 bricks
The bricks build a duck, a tower, a staircase and a bridge, each one clicking in stud by stud, exactly the way we built LEGO as kids
In a corner of the frame the step number keeps jumping up until it stops at 915,103,765
Every brick goes home and the square logo snaps back together, with LEGO pressed onto the studs
en.summary: That final square logo is one of more than 900 million possibilities. A second later, it could come apart and be built into something else.

zh.name: 苹果 Apple
idea: 苹果的 logo 为什么缺一口？设计师 Rob Janoff 说过一个很实在的原因：如果不咬那一口，logo 缩小以后，别人可能会把它看成一颗樱桃。
那我们就反过来玩：先让它真的当一回别的水果。1977 年苹果用的是彩虹 logo，从上到下六道颜色：绿、黄、橙、红、紫、蓝。六种颜色，正好对上六种水果。
beats: 苹果 logo 原地翻面，每翻一次就变成一种水果
青柠、柠檬、橙子、樱桃、葡萄、蓝莓，颜色顺序和当年的彩虹条一模一样
六种水果翻完，它变成了一颗苹果，可看上去还是有点像别的什么
直到被咬下一口，你才一眼认出来：哦，是苹果
彩虹褪去，回到 1998 年以后的单色 logo
zh.summary: 那一口不是缺陷，是它的身份证。所有水果里，只有被咬过一口的那个，才是苹果。

en.name: Apple
en.film: It Takes a Bite to Be an Apple
idea: Why is there a bite missing from the Apple logo? Designer Rob Janoff gave a very practical reason. Without the bite, people might mistake the shrunken logo for a cherry.

So we played it the other way around and let it really be some other fruit first. In 1977 Apple used a rainbow logo with six stripes, top to bottom: green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue. Six colors, six fruits.
beats: The Apple logo flips in place, turning into a different fruit with every flip
Lime, lemon, orange, cherry, grape, blueberry, in the same order as the old rainbow stripes
After all six fruits, it becomes an apple, though it still looks a bit like something else
Only when a bite is taken out do you recognize it at once: oh, it's an apple
The rainbow fades, back to the single-color logo Apple has used since 1998
en.summary: The bite is the apple's ID card. Of all the fruits, only the one with a bite taken out of it is an Apple.

zh.name: 谷歌 Google
idea: Google 这个名字，其实是一个拼错的数学词。原词是 googol，意思是 1 后面跟 100 个 0，一个大到几乎用不上的数。创始人想用它形容网上的信息多到数不清，结果注册域名时拼成了 google，就这么一直用了下来。
你搜东西翻到页面最底下，会看到那条 Gooooogle 翻页条，结果越多，o 就越多。那就让它一直长下去，长到真正的 googol。
beats: Google 中间的 o 一个接一个往外冒，字越拉越长
绿色的 l 是整个 logo 里唯一不按“蓝红黄蓝”顺序来的字母。这次它也不守规矩，翻个跟头冲到最前面，变成数字 1
1 的身后哗啦啦落下 100 个 0，打出“= googol”
屏幕下面冒出一行熟悉的小字：Did you mean: Google
zh.summary: 一个拼错的名字，变成了全世界每天都在输入的词。连它自己都会提醒你：你要找的是不是 Google？

en.name: Google
idea: The name Google is a misspelled math word. The original is googol: a 1 followed by 100 zeros, a number so big you almost never need it. The founders wanted it to describe how much information the web holds. When they registered the domain, it came out as google, and the name stuck.
Scroll to the bottom of a search results page and you see the Gooooogle page bar. The more results, the more o's. So we let it keep growing, all the way to a real googol.
beats: The o's in the middle of Google pop out one after another, and the word stretches longer and longer
The green l is the only letter in the logo that breaks the blue-red-yellow-blue pattern. It breaks the rules again here: it cartwheels to the front and turns into the number 1
100 zeros come tumbling down behind the 1, spelling out "= googol"
A familiar line of small text appears at the bottom of the screen: Did you mean: Google
en.summary: A misspelled name became a word the whole world types every day. Even Google itself will ask you: did you mean Google?

zh.name: 英伟达 NVIDIA
idea: NVIDIA 的名字来自拉丁语 invidia，意思是“嫉妒”，词根是“盯着看”。所以它的 logo 上，是一只绿色的眼睛。
显卡渲染有一条很基本的原则：看不见的东西不用画，把算力省下来画看得见的地方。这让我们想到小时候玩的“一二三木头人”：转过身的人看不见，大家就偷偷往前跑；他一回头，谁动谁就输。
beats: 绿眼睛一闭，整个世界退回成线框，像 3D 软件里还没渲染的样子
字母们趁它闭眼，偷偷乱跑
眼睛一睁，画面一格一格渲染出来，被看到的字母当场定住
眼球还会转，专门盯住那个偷偷动的字母
最后眼睛停住，所有字母都回到原位
zh.summary: 被看见的才会被画出来。这只眼睛不只是一个 logo，也是英伟达每天在做的事：替你盯住屏幕上的每一帧。

en.name: NVIDIA
idea: The name NVIDIA comes from the Latin invidia, "envy", whose root means "to look at". That is why the logo has a green eye.

Graphics rendering has a basic rule: don't draw what nobody can see, and save the power for what's in view. That reminded us of the playground game Red Light, Green Light. While the person in front has their back turned, everyone sneaks forward. The moment they turn around, anyone caught moving is out.
beats: The green eye closes, and the whole world drops back to wireframe, like an unrendered scene in 3D software
While the eye is shut, the letters sneak around
The eye opens, the picture renders tile by tile, and every letter it sees freezes on the spot
The eyeball can still turn, and it locks onto the one letter that keeps sneaking
Finally the eye holds still and every letter is back in place
en.summary: Only what is seen gets drawn. This eye is a logo, and it is also what NVIDIA does every day: watch every frame on your screen for you.

zh.name: 微信 WeChat
idea: 打开微信，启动页上是一个小小的人，站着望向一颗很大的地球。微信的 logo，是一个小气泡对着一个大气泡。仔细看，这两张图其实是同一个构图：一个小的，面对一个大的。
一个人面对整个世界，会觉得孤单；可只要发出一条消息，世界就有可能回你一句。这就是微信想讲的事。
beats: 镜头钻进大气泡的“眼睛”，进入那张熟悉的启动页
小人抬起手机，冒出一个小气泡
气泡绕着地球飞了一圈
地球从广州（微信诞生的地方）开始，一点点亮成绿色
最后整颗地球，变成了 logo 里那只大气泡
zh.summary: 小人发出去的那句话，地球回了。从孤单到连接，中间只隔着一条消息。

en.name: WeChat
idea: Open WeChat and the splash screen shows a tiny person standing and gazing at a huge Earth. The WeChat logo is a small speech bubble facing a big one. Look closely and the two pictures share one composition: something small facing something big.
One person facing the whole world can feel lonely. Send one message, though, and the world might write back. That is the story WeChat wants to tell.
beats: The camera dives into the "eyes" of the big bubble and lands in that familiar splash screen
The little figure raises a phone, and a small bubble pops out
The bubble flies once around the Earth
Starting from Guangzhou, where WeChat was born, the Earth lights up green bit by bit
In the end the whole planet becomes the big bubble in the logo
en.summary: The message the little figure sent got a reply from the Earth. Between lonely and connected, there is only one message.

zh.name: 宝马 BMW
zh.film: 一块翻过面的巴伐利亚
idea: 很多人以为宝马的蓝白圆标是一个转动的螺旋桨，其实这个说法来自 1929 年的一则广告，是后来才有的。蓝白格真正的来源，是宝马老家巴伐利亚的州旗。
有意思的是，当时的商标法不准公司直接用州的标志，所以宝马把蓝白的顺序反了过来。“反过来”，其实就是“翻了个面”。另外，BMW 的 W 是 Werke，德语里“工厂”的意思。
beats: 外圈的黑环和 BMW 字母，变成一副工厂里冲压用的模具
下面铺着一面巴伐利亚的蓝白菱形旗，模具“咔”地压下去，冲出一块圆布
圆布在空中翻了个面，蓝白的顺序也跟着倒了过来
圆布落回圆框，就是今天的宝马标
全片一个螺旋桨都没有
zh.summary: 这个 logo 讲的不是飞机，是家乡和工厂：从巴伐利亚的旗子上冲下一块，翻个面，带着它去造车。

en.name: BMW
idea: Many people think the blue-and-white BMW roundel is a spinning propeller. That story actually comes from a 1929 ad and was added later. The real source of the blue and white checks is the flag of Bavaria, BMW's home state.

Here's the fun part. Trademark law at the time didn't allow companies to use state symbols directly, so BMW reversed the order of the blue and white. Reversing it is the same as flipping it over. One more thing: the W in BMW stands for Werke, German for "works", as in a factory.
beats: The black outer ring and the letters BMW turn into a stamping die from a factory floor
Underneath lies a blue-and-white Bavarian diamond flag. The die slams down with a clack and punches out a round piece of cloth
The disc flips over in midair, and the blue and white swap places
The disc drops back into the ring, and it is the BMW roundel of today
There is not a single propeller in the whole film
en.summary: This logo is about home and the factory, with no airplane in sight. Punch a piece out of the Bavarian flag, flip it over, and take it along to build cars.

zh.name: 可口可乐 Coca-Cola
idea: 可口可乐那手漂亮的花体字标，从 1886 年一直用到今天；1915 年，又有了那只闭着眼都能摸出来的轮廓瓶。字和瓶，是可口可乐最有名的两样东西。
我们比了一下，发现一个巧合：字标的长宽比，差不多正好等于轮廓瓶的高宽比。一个是字，一个是瓶子，比例刚好一样，那就让字投出瓶子的影子。
beats: 红色的漆面上，白色的字标慢慢浮了起来
顶光一打，地上的影子竟然是一只躺着的可乐瓶
影子侧过身站起来，变成一只真正的瓶子
瓶子晃了晃，倒下，滚了一圈
又滚回字面，回到那行熟悉的字
zh.summary: 可口可乐的字和瓶，原来本来就是同一个东西。看见这行字，你脑子里就已经有了那只瓶子。

en.name: Coca-Cola
idea: Coca-Cola's elegant script wordmark has been in use from 1886 until today. In 1915 came the contour bottle, the one you could recognize with your eyes closed. The script and the bottle are the two most famous things Coca-Cola owns.

We measured them and found a coincidence. The width-to-height ratio of the wordmark is almost exactly the height-to-width ratio of the contour bottle. One is lettering, one is a bottle, and their proportions match. So we let the lettering cast the bottle's shadow.
beats: On a red lacquered surface, the white script slowly lifts up
A top light switches on, and the shadow on the ground turns out to be a Coca-Cola bottle lying on its side
The shadow rolls onto its edge and stands up as a real bottle
The bottle wobbles, tips over and rolls a full turn
It rolls back into the lettering, and we are back to the familiar script
en.summary: Coca-Cola's lettering and its bottle were the same thing all along. When you see the script, the bottle is already in your head.

zh.name: 耐克 Nike
idea: Nike 是希腊神话里的胜利女神，那个勾（Swoosh）就是“赢”的形状。它是 1971 年一位大学生设计的，当时只收了 35 美元。
赢在赛场上最具体的样子是什么？是冠军用胸口撞上终点线的那一下。那条被撞弯的撞线带，本身就是一道弧线。
beats: 从头顶俯视一条跑道的终点线，午后的阳光拉出长长的影子
五名跑者冲过来，每个人的姿势都不一样
冠军第一个用胸口撞上撞线带
带子被压弯，甩出一道弯钩，再慢慢拧平，变成 Swoosh
终点摄影“咔”地一闪，画面定格
zh.summary: Swoosh 不是凭空画出来的一道勾，而是冲线那一瞬间留下的形状。每次看到它，都是在看一次“赢”。

en.name: Nike
idea: Nike is the goddess of victory in Greek mythology, and the Swoosh is the shape of winning. It was designed in 1971 by a college student, who was paid just $35.
What does winning look like at its most concrete? It is the moment the champion hits the finish tape with their chest. The tape bends under the impact, and that bend is already a curve.
beats: Looking straight down at the finish line of a track, the afternoon sun stretches long shadows
Five runners charge in, each with a different stride
The champion hits the finish tape chest-first
The tape bends, whips into a hook, then slowly untwists and flattens into the Swoosh
The photo-finish camera flashes with a click and the frame freezes
en.summary: The Swoosh is the shape left behind at the instant someone crosses the line. Every time you see it, you are watching a win.

zh.name: 宜家 IKEA
idea: 1956 年，宜家的一位员工想把一张桌子塞进车里拉回去，怎么都塞不进，干脆把桌腿卸了下来。平板包装就是从这一刻开始的。
我们从上往下看宜家的 logo，突然觉得它就是一张装在盒子里的椭圆桌：黄色椭圆是桌面，字母是桌腿。右上角那个小小的 ®，像极了每次组装完都会多出来的那颗零件。
beats: 宜家 logo 平放着，就是一张还没组装的桌子
桌子从盒子里倒扣着立起来，像我们组装时先翻过来装腿
那颗多出来的凸轮锁（®）滚走了，桌子起身去追
追了半天没追上，干脆“啪”地一下拍回盒子里，又变回 logo
zh.summary: 装过宜家家具的人都懂：说明书看完了，桌子装好了，手里还剩一颗零件。这支片就是送给这一刻的。

en.name: IKEA
idea: In 1956, an IKEA employee wanted to take a table home in his car. It wouldn't fit no matter how he tried, so he took the legs off. Flat-pack began at that moment.

Looking down at the IKEA logo, we suddenly saw a boxed oval table. The yellow oval is the tabletop and the letters are the legs. The tiny ® in the top right corner looks exactly like the part that is always left over after you finish assembling.
beats: The IKEA logo lies flat: a table that hasn't been assembled yet
The table rises out of the box upside down, the way we flip it over to attach the legs
The leftover cam lock (the ®) rolls away, and the table gets up to chase it
After a long chase it gives up, slaps itself back into the box, and turns into the logo again
en.summary: Anyone who has built IKEA furniture knows the feeling: you've read the manual, the table is done, and there's still one part in your hand. This film is for that moment.

zh.name: 联邦快递 FedEx
idea: FedEx 的 logo 里藏着一支白色箭头，就在 E 和 x 之间。很多人看了几十年都没发现，可一旦发现，就再也忘不掉。
联邦快递是靠“隔夜送达”起家的：1973 年开业的第一个晚上，14 架小飞机从孟菲斯起飞，连夜把包裹送往全美各地。这家公司真正忙的时候，是大家都睡着的时候。
beats: 天黑了，画面暗下来
藏在 E 和 x 之间的箭头，从缝里溜了出来
它从孟菲斯出发，飞向北美各个城市，一趟又一趟，在地图上叠出一张航线网
天快亮了，箭头赶在第一缕光之前落回缝里
白天，一支巨大的箭头把画面推回 logo
zh.summary: logo 从紫到橙，正好可以读成从深夜到早晨。你早上醒来收到的包裹，就是这支箭头昨晚一夜没睡的结果。

en.name: FedEx
idea: There is a white arrow hidden in the FedEx logo, right between the E and the x. Many people looked at it for decades without noticing. Once you find it, you can never unsee it.

FedEx was built on overnight delivery. On its first night in business in 1973, 14 small planes took off from Memphis and carried packages across the United States overnight. The company does its real work while everyone else is asleep.
beats: Night falls and the picture goes dark
The arrow hidden between the E and the x slips out through the gap
It sets off from Memphis and flies to cities all over North America, trip after trip, layering a web of routes across the map
Just before dawn, the arrow drops back into the gap ahead of the first light
By day, a giant arrow pushes the frame back to the logo
en.summary: From purple to orange, the logo reads like late night turning into morning. The package you get when you wake up is what this arrow stayed up all night to bring.

zh.name: 米其林 Michelin
idea: 1898 年，米其林发了一张海报：轮胎人举起一杯钉子和碎玻璃，旁边写着一句拉丁文 Nunc est bibendum，意思是“现在，干杯吧”。米其林想说：路上的钉子和碎玻璃，我们的轮胎一口就能喝掉，扎不破。
轮胎人后来就叫 Bibendum，名字就是从这句话来的。一百多年后，我们想让他把这杯“酒”再喝一次。
beats: 用老式橡皮管卡通的手感，重演那张 1898 年的海报
轮胎人举起一杯满是钉子和碎玻璃的“酒”
一饮而尽，没被扎破，反而越鼓越大
“噗”地一下缩回原样
打了三个嗝，冒出三颗星，正好是米其林指南的最高评级
zh.summary: 一个卖轮胎的品牌，后来做出了全世界最有名的美食指南。这一杯，从轮胎一路喝到了餐桌。

en.name: Michelin
idea: In 1898, Michelin put out a poster. The tire man raises a glass full of nails and broken glass, next to a Latin line: Nunc est bibendum, "Now is the time to drink." Michelin's point: our tires can swallow the nails and glass on the road in one gulp and never get punctured.
The tire man was later named Bibendum, after that very line. More than a hundred years on, we wanted him to drink that "wine" one more time.
beats: In the feel of old rubber-hose cartoons, we restage the 1898 poster
The tire man raises a "drink" full of nails and broken glass
He downs it in one go. He doesn't get punctured. He puffs up bigger and bigger instead
With a pop, he shrinks back to normal
He burps three times, and out come three stars, the top rating in the Michelin Guide
en.summary: A tire brand went on to make the world's most famous food guide. This one drink went all the way from the tires to the dinner table.

zh.name: 微软 Microsoft
idea: 很多人第一次摸电脑，玩的不是 Word，也不是 Excel，而是 Windows 自带的纸牌。最爽的是通关那一刻：牌从四个收牌堆里一张张蹦出来，在屏幕上弹出一长串残影。
纸牌有四个收牌堆，微软的 logo 正好也是四个方块、四种颜色。这么巧，那就让 logo 也通一次关。
beats: 四个彩色方块，变成纸牌的四个收牌堆
每一堆最上面的 K 跳了出去，满屏弹出那串带黑边的牌影，和当年一模一样
然后牌被一张张拽回格子里
压平，变回四色方块
最后一击，旁边的 Microsoft 字标被震了一下
zh.summary: 对很多人来说，这串蹦跳的纸牌，就是他们对“电脑”最早的记忆。微软的四个方块，也装着几代人在办公室里偷偷通关的那几分钟。

en.name: Microsoft
idea: For a lot of people, the first thing they did on a computer wasn't Word or Excel. It was the Solitaire game that came with Windows. The best part was winning: the cards bounce out of the four foundation piles one by one and leave long trails across the screen.
Solitaire has four foundation piles. The Microsoft logo happens to be four squares in four colors. Too good a match to pass up, so we let the logo win a game too.
beats: The four colored squares become the four foundation piles of Solitaire
The King on top of each pile leaps out, and the screen fills with those black-edged card trails, exactly like back then
Then the cards get dragged back into their slots one by one
They press flat and turn back into the four colored squares
One last hit gives the Microsoft wordmark beside them a jolt
en.summary: For many people, those bouncing cards are their earliest memory of a computer. Microsoft's four squares also hold the few minutes generations of office workers spent sneaking in a game.

zh.name: 亚马逊 Amazon
idea: 亚马逊 logo 下面那道橙色的弧，既是一张笑脸，也是一支箭头，从 a 指向 z，意思是“从 A 到 Z，什么都卖”。而对大多数人来说，亚马逊最具体的样子，是门口那只印着笑脸的纸箱。
所以我们想：logo 下面那片白，会不会就是一只纸箱的内面？
beats: 白色的背景，其实是一只摊平的纸箱
字母们跳进箱子，盖子合上，胶带封好
箱子被寄出去，过了一会儿“砰”地砸回来，到了
撕胶带的时候，撕下来的那一条在空中卷成了那道微笑
盖子弹开，字母一个个蹦出来，回到原位
纸箱拍平，又变回一张白纸
zh.summary: 整支片就是一单快递的一生。logo 上的那个笑，就是你撕开包装那一下的笑。

en.name: Amazon
en.film: The White Is the Inside of the Box
idea: The orange curve under the Amazon logo is a smile and an arrow at once. It points from a to z, meaning Amazon sells everything from A to Z. And for most people, Amazon's most concrete form is the box with a smile printed on it, sitting at the front door.
So we wondered: what if the white under the logo is the inside of a shipping box?
beats: The white background is actually a box laid out flat
The letters jump into the box, the lid closes, and tape seals it shut
The box gets shipped off, and a moment later it lands back with a thud: delivered
As the tape is ripped off, the strip curls in midair into that smile
The lid pops open, and the letters spring out one by one back to their places
The box folds flat and turns back into a sheet of white paper
en.summary: The whole film is the life of one delivery. The smile on the logo is the smile you have the moment you tear open the package.

zh.name: Meta
idea: Meta 的标是一根闭合的环，中间只交叉了一次。从正面看是一个形状，换个角度看，又是另一个形状。
一根绳，交叉一次，换个角度就变样，这不就是小时候玩的翻花绳吗？翻花绳一个人玩不了，必须两个人你翻一下、我接一下。这也正是 Meta 一直在说的：把人连在一起。
beats: logo 上的那个环，原来是一根蓝色的绳子
两只不同肤色的手伸过来，接住了它
绷直，翻腕，拧成一个 ∞
再往上一撑，撑成 Meta 的形状
一松手，绳子落回纸面，把旁边的字母震回原位
zh.summary: 这个 logo 只有在两个人之间才能成形。连接，从来不是一个人的事。

en.name: Meta
idea: The Meta symbol is a single closed loop that crosses itself just once. From the front it is one shape. Tilt it, and it becomes another.

One string, one crossing, a new shape from every angle. That is the cat's cradle game we played as kids. You can't play cat's cradle alone. It takes two people, one passing and one catching. That is exactly what Meta keeps talking about: bringing people together.
beats: The loop in the logo turns out to be a blue string
Two hands with different skin tones reach in and catch it
They pull it taut, turn their wrists, and twist it into ∞
One more push upward stretches it into the Meta shape
They let go, the string drops back onto the page, and the bump knocks the letters beside it back into place
en.summary: This logo only takes shape between two people. Connection always takes more than one.

zh.name: 三星 Samsung
idea: 仔细看三星的英文字标 SAMSUNG，里面的 A 是没有横杠的。少了这一横，七个字母就都成了一笔能画完、不分叉的形状。
一笔画完、不分叉，意味着每个字母都能用一整块柔性屏折出来，而三星最出名的正是折叠屏手机。再加上“三星”这个名字本来就是“三颗星”的意思，手机系列又叫 Galaxy（星河）。
beats: 七台折叠屏手机并排躺着，屏幕连成一片星空
三颗星从屏幕上闪过，对上“三星”这个名字
手机一台接一台折起来
每一台都折成一个字母：S、A、M、S、U、N、G
最后停成那行蓝色的字标
zh.summary: 一行字，七块屏。那个少了一横的 A，让每一个字母都刚好能被一块屏“折”出来。

en.name: Samsung
idea: Look closely at the SAMSUNG wordmark and you'll see the A has no crossbar. Without that bar, every one of the seven letters becomes a shape you can draw in a single stroke with no branches.

One stroke, no branches, means every letter can be folded from a single flexible screen, and Samsung is best known for its foldable phones. On top of that, the name Samsung means "three stars", and its phone line is called Galaxy.
beats: Seven foldable phones lie side by side, their screens joining into one starry sky
Three stars flash across the screens, a nod to the name "three stars"
The phones fold up one after another
Each one folds into a letter: S, A, M, S, U, N, G
They settle into the blue wordmark
en.summary: One word, seven screens. That A without its crossbar is what lets every letter be folded from a single screen.

zh.name: 网飞 Netflix
idea: “刷剧”这个习惯，很大程度上是 Netflix 带火的：一季剧一次放完，看完一集自动播下一集。看得太久，屏幕上还会弹出一句很懂你的提示：Are you still watching?（你还在看吗？）
Netflix 的红色字标本来就是弯的，中间低、两头高，像一排弧形沙发。那七个字母，就是坐在沙发上刷剧的七个人。
beats: 七个字母坐在弧形沙发上，一起盯着屏幕
看动作片，大家跟着镜头一起左倒右倒
看恐怖片，吓得一起弹起来
看喜剧，笑得往后仰
看到一部慢片，一个压着一个睡着了
屏幕弹出“Are you still watching?”，按下继续，全体一激灵坐直
坐直的那一刻，就是 Netflix 的 logo
zh.summary: 这支片拍的不是 Netflix，而是看 Netflix 的我们。每个熬夜刷剧的人，都在这排沙发上坐过。

en.name: Netflix
idea: Binge-watching took off in large part because of Netflix: a whole season released at once, and the next episode playing automatically when one ends. Watch long enough and a prompt pops up that knows you a little too well: Are you still watching?
The red Netflix wordmark already curves, low in the middle and high at both ends, like a curved sofa. The seven letters are seven people on that sofa, binge-watching.
beats: Seven letters sit on a curved sofa, all staring at the screen
During an action movie, they all lean left and right with the camera
During a horror movie, they jump up together in fright
During a comedy, they laugh so hard they fall back
During a slow film, they doze off, slumped on top of one another
"Are you still watching?" pops up on screen. Someone hits Continue, and everyone jolts upright
The moment they sit up straight, they are the Netflix logo
en.summary: This film is about us, the people watching Netflix. Everyone who has stayed up late bingeing a show has sat on this sofa.

zh.name: Spotify
idea: Spotify 有一个几乎人人都按过的按钮：Shuffle，随机播放。Shuffle 这个词，本来就是“洗牌”的意思。
一张歌单就是一副牌，每首歌是一张牌，按下随机播放，就是把这副牌洗一遍。再看 Spotify 的 logo，三道白弧的粗细，刚好能对上一张扑克牌的长宽比。
beats: 绿色的 logo 变成一张绿色毡面的牌桌
三道白弧，是三排摊开的牌，翻开来每一张都是一首歌
切牌、鸽尾洗、搭桥，像牌桌上的荷官一样洗了一遍
牌摊成一个彩色的圆环
再一摞、一拍，摊回三道弧，翻回白色的牌背
zh.summary: 每次按下随机播放，你都在洗一副只属于你的牌。下一首会是什么，正是听歌最好玩的地方。

en.name: Spotify
idea: Spotify has a button almost everyone has pressed: Shuffle. The word shuffle comes from shuffling cards.

A playlist is a deck of cards, and every song is a card. Hitting Shuffle is shuffling the deck. Look at the Spotify logo again: the thickness of its three white arcs lines up with the proportions of a playing card.
beats: The green logo becomes a green felt card table
The three white arcs are three spreads of cards, and each card flips over to reveal a song
A cut, a riffle, a bridge: the deck gets shuffled like a dealer would do it
The cards spread out into a colorful ring
They gather into a stack, get a tap, and spread back into three arcs, flipping over to their white backs
en.summary: Every time you press Shuffle, you are shuffling a deck that belongs only to you. Not knowing what comes next is the best part of listening.

zh.name: 阿里巴巴 Alibaba
idea: 阿里巴巴这个名字，出自《一千零一夜》里《阿里巴巴与四十大盗》的故事：念一句“芝麻开门”，宝库的大门就开了。马云选这个名字，是希望它能替小生意打开财富的大门。logo 里那个带笑脸的 a，是一位微笑的客户。
一个阿拉伯故事，一家中国公司。我们就用中国的皮影戏，来演这个阿拉伯故事。
beats: 白色的背景是一块皮影戏的幕布，后面亮着一盏灯
大写的 A 退到灯前，影子被放大成一座宝山，把其他字母关进了山门
笑脸 a 丢了笑容，作了个揖
喊出四枚字牌：芝、麻、开、门
字牌撞开大门，金光、铜钱、元宝喷了出来
字母们蹦回原位，笑脸也回来了
zh.summary: 宝库的门是喊开的，客户的笑是门开了才有的。这就是阿里巴巴想做的事：替做生意的人把门打开。

en.name: Alibaba
idea: The name Alibaba comes from "Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves" in the Arabian Nights. Say "Open Sesame" and the treasure cave opens. Jack Ma chose the name hoping the company would open the door to wealth for small businesses. The smiling a in the logo is a smiling customer.
An Arabian tale, a Chinese company. So we told the Arabian story with Chinese shadow puppetry.
beats: The white background is a shadow-puppet screen, with a lamp glowing behind it
The capital A steps back toward the lamp, and its shadow swells into a treasure mountain that shuts the other letters behind its gate
The smiling a loses its smile and bows with its hands clasped
It calls out four character tiles: 芝, 麻, 开, 门, Chinese for "Open Sesame"
The tiles smash the gate open, and golden light, copper coins and gold ingots burst out
The letters bounce back into place, and the smile comes back too
en.summary: The treasure gate opens when you call out to it, and the customer smiles once the gate is open. That is what Alibaba wants to do: open the door for people doing business.

zh.name: 奔驰 Mercedes-Benz
idea: 奔驰的三叉星，最早出现在一张明信片上。19 世纪 70 年代，戈特利布·戴姆勒在寄给妻子的明信片上，用一颗星标出了自己在德国 Deutz 的住处，还写下一句话：有一天，这颗星会在我自己的工厂上空升起。
多年以后，他的两个儿子想起了这张明信片，于是这颗星成了奔驰的标志。一句写在明信片上的话，后来真的实现了。
beats: 三叉星“啪”地拍在一张 19 世纪的 Deutz 明信片上，变成一颗钢笔画的星
明信片像立体书一样打开，房子立了起来
房子越长越大，长成了一座工厂
星从工厂上空升起，像太阳一样
明信片上的邮戳，变成了外面那个圆环，套在星上
zh.summary: 这支片讲的是一句话怎样变成现实：一个人在明信片上画了一颗星，后来它真的升到了自己的工厂上空。

en.name: Mercedes-Benz
idea: The Mercedes three-pointed star first appeared on a postcard. In the 1870s, Gottlieb Daimler sent his wife a postcard and marked his home in Deutz, Germany, with a star. He wrote that one day this star would rise over his own factory.
Years later, his two sons remembered that postcard, and the star became the Mercedes-Benz emblem. A line written on a postcard really did come true.
beats: The three-pointed star slaps down onto a 19th-century Deutz postcard and turns into a star drawn in fountain pen
The postcard opens like a pop-up book, and the house stands up
The house keeps growing until it becomes a factory
The star rises over the factory like the sun
The postmark on the card becomes the outer ring and slips around the star
en.summary: This film is about how a sentence becomes real. A man drew a star on a postcard, and later it really did rise over his own factory.

zh.name: 麦当劳 McDonald's
idea: 1948 年，麦当劳兄弟想把厨房改成流水线，又不想直接动工，就跑到网球场上，用粉笔画出厨房的平面图，让员工在线里一遍遍排练：谁站哪里、谁递什么、几秒出一份汉堡。快餐流水线，就是从这块网球场开始的。
1953 年，新开的餐厅屋顶两侧立起了两座金色的拱门。从斜前方看过去，两座拱叠在一起，正好是一个 M。今天的金色 M，最早其实是一栋建筑。
beats: 一截粉笔在网球场上画厨房，画错了还擦掉重画
餐厅从粉笔线里慢慢长出来：墙、屋顶、招牌
两座金色的拱门冲破屋顶
镜头绕到斜前方，两座拱正好叠成一个 M
霓虹灯亮起，开门营业
zh.summary: 从粉笔线到金色 M，讲的是麦当劳怎样从一个想法变成一栋楼，再变成全世界都认得的一个字母。

en.name: McDonald's
idea: In 1948, the McDonald brothers wanted to turn their kitchen into an assembly line, but they didn't want to start building right away. So they went to a tennis court, drew the kitchen floor plan in chalk, and had their staff rehearse inside the lines over and over: who stands where, who hands over what, how many seconds per burger. The fast-food assembly line started on that tennis court.
In 1953, the new restaurant had two golden arches rising from either side of its roof. Seen from the front at an angle, the two arches overlap into an M. Today's golden M started life as a building.
beats: A stick of chalk draws a kitchen on a tennis court, rubbing out mistakes and drawing them again
The restaurant slowly grows out of the chalk lines: walls, roof, sign
Two golden arches burst up through the roof
The camera swings around to the front corner, and the two arches line up into an M
The neon lights up and the restaurant opens for business
en.summary: From chalk lines to a golden M, this is how McDonald's went from an idea to a building, and then to a letter the whole world recognizes.

zh.name: 万事达 Mastercard
idea: 万事达卡的 logo 是一红一黄两个圆，重叠的地方是橙色。简单到几乎不用解释，但我们想给它一个解释：两个圆是一笔交易的两方，买东西的人和卖东西的人。支付网络最核心的工作，就是让这两方把账结清，这一步叫“结算”。
beats: 红色和黄色两枚圆片，像硬币一样从桌上弹起来
两枚圆片绕着彼此转，越转越低，越转越快
“嗒、嗒、叮”，三声落定
就在两枚圆片重叠的那一刻，中间才亮起橙色
zh.summary: 橙色不是一开始就在那儿的，它只在两方真正碰到一起时才出现。你每刷一次卡，这两个圆就在某个地方重叠一次。

en.name: Mastercard
idea: The Mastercard logo is two circles, one red and one yellow, overlapping in orange. It is so simple it barely needs explaining, but we wanted to give it an explanation anyway. The two circles are the two sides of a transaction: the person buying and the person selling. The core job of a payment network is to let those two sides square up. That step is called settlement.
beats: A red disc and a yellow disc bounce up off a table like coins
The two discs spin around each other, lower and lower, faster and faster
Tap, tap, ting: three sounds, and they settle
Only at the moment the two discs overlap does the middle light up orange
en.summary: The orange only shows up when the two sides truly meet. Every time you swipe your card, these two circles overlap somewhere.

zh.name: IBM
idea: IBM 的条纹 logo 是设计大师 Paul Rand 1972 年画的，八道横条让三个粗重的字母一下子轻快起来，有了速度感。
我们盯着这八道横条看了很久，突然觉得它像一样东西：一摞硬盘盘片，正好从正侧面看过去。等宽、平行、中间留着缝。而硬盘，正是 IBM 发明的。1956 年的 IBM 350 RAMAC 有 50 片 24 英寸的盘片，两台冰箱那么大，总共只能存 3.75 MB。
beats: 镜头一抬，八道横条张开，原来是八片银色盘片，IBM 三个字母印在盘片边上
盘片转起来，字母被甩成八道品牌蓝的速度带
磁头臂甩进盘缝，每落一次，盘面上就亮起一圈蓝色磁道
角落里一行字逐个打出来：IBM 350 · RAMAC · 1956 · 3.75 MB
磁道推到盘缘，盘片一片一片“咔”地对位，拼回 IBM，压盘一夹，收工
zh.summary: Paul Rand 说条纹代表速度。我们只是把这个速度真的转了起来。今天手机里随便一张照片都比 3.75 MB 大，但硬盘的故事是从这一摞盘片开始的。

en.name: IBM
idea: The striped IBM logo was drawn by design master Paul Rand in 1972. Eight horizontal bars made three heavy letters feel light and quick, with a sense of speed.

We stared at those eight bars for a long time until they suddenly looked like something else: a stack of hard disk platters, seen exactly edge-on. Equal widths, parallel, with gaps between them. And IBM invented the hard disk. The 1956 IBM 350 RAMAC had 50 platters, each 24 inches across. It was as big as two refrigerators and held a grand total of 3.75 MB.
beats: The camera tilts up and the eight bars spread apart. They are eight silver platters, with the letters IBM printed on their edges
The platters start spinning, and the letters smear into eight bands of brand blue
An actuator arm swings into the gaps, and each time it lands, a blue track lights up on the platter
In a corner, a line types itself out letter by letter: IBM 350 · RAMAC · 1956 · 3.75 MB
The tracks reach the edge, the platters click into alignment one by one to form IBM again, the clamp locks down, and that's a wrap
en.summary: Paul Rand said the stripes stand for speed. We just made that speed actually spin. Any photo on your phone today is bigger than 3.75 MB, but the story of the hard disk started with this stack of platters.

zh.name: 壳牌 Shell
idea: 壳牌的名字真的来自贝壳。1833 年，Marcus Samuel 在伦敦开了一家小店，卖从远东运来的贝壳。后来他的两个儿子做起海运生意，每条油轮都用一种贝壳命名。1904 年起，logo 就是一只扇贝。
然后我们查到一个冷知识：扇贝会游泳。它猛地合上两片壳，把水从壳底两侧喷出去，一窜一窜地往前游，壳边还长着一圈蓝色的小眼睛。壳牌 logo 底部那两只小“翅膀”，恰好就是扇贝喷水的地方。
beats: 白底化成浅海的沙床，logo 长出弧度，变成一只真扇贝
它张开壳，露出一圈蓝色的小眼睛
连着四次猛合壳，水和气泡从底部两只“耳朵”喷出去，之字形往上游
它立起来对着镜头大张口，再用力一合，往上一蹿
最后仰面倒下，像落叶一样摆着沉回沙里，海水退去，变回 logo
zh.summary: 一个 logo 用了一百多年，大家早就把它当成一个图形。可它本来是一只活的扇贝，我们只是让它想起自己会游泳。

en.name: Shell
idea: Shell really is named after seashells. In 1833, Marcus Samuel opened a small shop in London selling shells shipped from the Far East. His two sons later went into shipping, and they named each of their oil tankers after a kind of shell. Since 1904, the logo has been a scallop.

Then we came across a piece of trivia: scallops can swim. A scallop snaps its two shells shut and jets water out from both sides of the hinge, darting forward in bursts. Around the edge of its shell it has a ring of small blue eyes. The two little "wings" at the bottom of the Shell logo are exactly where a scallop shoots out its water.
beats: The white background melts into a sandy shallow seabed, and the logo gains depth and becomes a real scallop
It opens its shell and shows a ring of small blue eyes
It snaps shut four times in a row, water and bubbles shooting out of the two "ears" at the bottom, and zigzags upward
It stands up, opens wide at the camera, then claps shut hard and shoots upward
Finally it flips onto its back and sways down into the sand like a falling leaf. The water drains away and it is the logo again
en.summary: After more than a hundred years, everyone sees this logo as a graphic. It started as a living scallop. We just reminded it that it can swim.

zh.name: 丰田 Toyota
idea: 丰田是织布机起家的。创始人丰田佐吉从小看母亲手工织布太辛苦，一辈子都在改织机。1924 年他做出 G 型自动织机，最厉害的一点是：线一断，机器自己停下。这个“出了问题马上停”的思想后来叫“自働化”，成了丰田生产方式的基石。
卖织机专利的钱，成了儿子丰田喜一郎造汽车的启动资金。丰田的椭圆标志，也常被人解读成一根线穿过针眼。
beats: 镜头钻进一台织机，白底原来是一匹白棉布
木梭拖着红线，慢镜头穿过经线，打出第一行红
机器越织越快，丰田的标志从布上一行一行织出来
突然红线绷断，整台机器在同一刻停住，世界褪成灰色，只剩红线还有颜色
两个线头弹回来打了个结，颜色回来，机器重启，把标志织完
zh.summary: 很多人知道丰田会造车，不知道它最早造的是织机。这个标志里藏着的，是一根线，和一台断了线会自己停下来的机器。

en.name: Toyota
idea: Toyota started out with looms. As a boy, founder Sakichi Toyoda watched his mother weave by hand and saw how hard it was, and he spent his life improving the loom. In 1924 he built the Type G automatic loom. Its best trick: when a thread broke, the machine stopped by itself. This idea of stopping the moment something goes wrong came to be called jidoka, and it became a cornerstone of the Toyota Production System.
The money from selling the loom patent became the seed funding for his son, Kiichiro Toyoda, to build cars. Toyota's oval emblem is also often read as a thread passing through the eye of a needle.
beats: The camera dives into a loom, and the white background turns out to be a bolt of white cotton
A wooden shuttle drags a red thread through the warp in slow motion, weaving the first row of red
The machine weaves faster and faster, and the Toyota emblem appears on the cloth row by row
Suddenly the red thread snaps. The whole machine stops in the same instant, and the world fades to gray with only the red thread still in color
The two loose ends spring back and tie a knot. The color returns, the machine restarts, and it finishes weaving the emblem
en.summary: Many people know Toyota makes cars. Few know it first made looms. Hidden in this emblem is a single thread, and a machine that stops on its own when the thread breaks.

zh.name: 奥迪 Audi
idea: 1909 年，August Horch 被挤出了自己创办的汽车公司。他另起炉灶，却不能再用自己的姓做品牌。一位合伙人正在学拉丁文的儿子出了个主意：德语 horch 是“听！”，翻成拉丁文就是 audi。
至于四个环，是 1932 年合并的四家车厂：Audi、DKW、Horch、Wanderer。我们想到了另一层：中国车迷管奥迪叫“灯厂”。如果这四个环，是一辆拉力车车顶上的四盏圆射灯呢？
beats: 白底像强光一样收进灯面，画面暗成雪夜，四盏灯随着车退到坡顶后面
车还没露面，先听见它：引擎一声比一声近，路上的雪粉一排排跳起来，树上的雪被震落
坡顶后面升起光柱，车飞出来，从月亮前面掠过，四个轮子一起落地扬起雪
车急刹停在镜头前，四盏黑框圆灯清清楚楚地扣在一起
灯光铺满画面，车、树、月亮都被吞成白色，只剩四个黑环
zh.summary: Audi 的意思是“听”。所以这支片子里，你先听到它，然后才看见它。而 logo 里的白，就是它的灯光。

en.name: Audi
idea: In 1909, August Horch was pushed out of the car company he had founded. He started over, but he could no longer use his own surname as the brand. A partner's son, who was studying Latin, had an idea: horch is German for "listen!", and in Latin that is audi.

The four rings stand for four carmakers that merged in 1932: Audi, DKW, Horch and Wanderer. We found another layer too. Chinese car fans nickname Audi "the light factory" for its headlights. What if the four rings were four round spotlights on the roof of a rally car?
beats: The white background shrinks into the lamp lenses like a blinding light. The scene darkens into a snowy night, and the four lamps sink back with the car behind the crest of a hill
The car is heard before it is seen: the engine gets closer with every roar, the powder snow on the road jumps up row by row, and snow shakes loose from the trees
Beams of light rise behind the hilltop. The car flies out, sweeps past the moon, and lands on all four wheels in a spray of snow
It brakes hard right in front of the camera, and the four black-rimmed round lamps sit clearly linked together
The light floods the frame. The car, trees and moon are swallowed into white, leaving only four black rings
en.summary: Audi means "listen". So in this film you hear it first, then you see it. And the white in the logo is its light.

zh.name: 阿迪达斯 adidas
idea: 阿迪达斯的三条杠，最早不是装饰，是功能：缝在鞋的侧面，用来加固、稳住脚的中段。
我们把现在这个“山形”logo 侧过来看，发现它就是一只高帮鞋的侧面：三条杠正是鞋侧的那三道，三根杠的顶端连起来是系鞋带的鞋口，下面的 adidas 字样刚好落在鞋底上。
beats: 灯光暗下来，一只白色高帮鞋从 logo 里浮出来，logo 一笔没动
鞋带松开，鞋口塌下来，三条杠软成三根松垮的皮条
鞋带被一把拽紧，三条杠由矮到高依次绷直
鞋被鞋带拎离地面，再重重落下，扬起一圈白灰
灯重新亮起，鞋溶回白底，只剩标准 logo
zh.summary: 三条杠的“山”，不是画出来的，是被鞋带拉起来的。七十多年前它的工作是撑住一只脚，今天它还在干同一件事。

en.name: adidas
idea: The adidas three stripes started as function, with no decoration in mind. They were stitched onto the side of the shoe to reinforce it and hold the midfoot steady.

We turned today's "mountain" logo on its side and found a high-top shoe in profile. The three stripes are the three bands on the side of the shoe, the tops of the stripes join up into the laced opening, and the adidas lettering below sits right where the sole would be.
beats: The lights dim, and a white high-top shoe rises out of the logo without a single line of the logo moving
The laces loosen, the collar slumps, and the three stripes go limp like three slack leather straps
The laces get yanked tight, and the stripes snap straight one by one, shortest to tallest
The laces lift the shoe off the ground, then it slams back down in a puff of white dust
The lights come back up, the shoe melts into the white background, and only the standard logo remains
en.summary: The mountain of three stripes was pulled up by the laces. More than seventy years ago its job was to hold a foot in place, and today it is still doing the same job.

zh.name: PlayStation
idea: PlayStation 的 PS 标志是索尼设计师坂本学 1994 年画的：一个 P 竖着站，一个 S 平躺在地上。
我们越看越觉得，这像格斗游戏里 KO 的那一帧：P 站着，赢了；S 被打趴在地上。而手柄上那四个符号也各有来历：△ 是视角，□ 是一张纸，○ 和 × 是“是”和“否”。
beats: 灯一关，白底沉成深夜的 PlayStation 蓝，屏幕上方亮起两条血条
被打趴的 S 翻身弹起来：REMATCH，再来一局
两个字母对打，P 打出 × ○ △ 三连击，每一下都炸出对应的符号
最后一招 □，把 S 重新拍平在地上：K.O.
P 落在它前面，姿势正好就是 PS 标志，灯亮，回到 logo
zh.summary: PS 标志里本来就有一个赢家和一个输家。而片子首尾相接，循环一次就是又打了一局，Play Has No Limits。

en.name: PlayStation
idea: The PS logo was drawn in 1994 by Sony designer Manabu Sakamoto: a P standing upright and an S lying flat on the ground.

The longer we looked, the more it resembled the K.O. frame in a fighting game. P is standing: the winner. S is knocked flat. The four symbols on the controller each have a story too: △ is a point of view, □ is a sheet of paper, ○ and × mean yes and no.
beats: The lights go out, the white background sinks into late-night PlayStation blue, and two health bars light up at the top of the screen
The knocked-down S flips back to its feet: REMATCH
The two letters fight. P lands a × ○ △ combo, and each hit bursts into its symbol
The finishing move, □, slams S flat on the ground again: K.O.
P lands in front of it in exactly the pose of the PS logo. The lights come on, and we're back to the logo
en.summary: The PS logo already holds a winner and a loser. The film's end runs into its start, so every loop is one more round. Play Has No Limits.

zh.name: 爱彼迎 Airbnb
idea: 2007 年，Brian Chesky 和 Joe Gebbia 在旧金山交不起房租。正好城里开设计大会，酒店全满。他们在客厅地板上铺了三张充气床垫，提供早餐，挂到网上，名字就叫 AirBed & Breakfast。
Airbnb 的 logo 叫 Bélo，一笔画里藏着一个张开双臂的人、一个定位针、一颗心和字母 A。可在我们眼里，它首先是一根管子，一根可以打满气的管子。
beats: logo 漏了气，瘪在木地板上起皱
一只穿袜子的脚踩着打气筒，一下、两下、三下，每一口气都顺着 Bélo 鼓过去
打满气的 Bélo 站起来，像一个张开双臂迎客的人
它向后扑通躺回地板，变回一张床
落地的震动传过去，airbnb 几个字母一个个鼓起来，蹦一下
zh.summary: 今天的 Airbnb 有几百万套房源，但它的第一张“床”，就是客厅地板上的一张充气床垫。

en.name: Airbnb
idea: In 2007, Brian Chesky and Joe Gebbia couldn't make rent in San Francisco. A design conference was in town and the hotels were full. They laid three air mattresses on their living room floor, offered breakfast, and put it online under the name AirBed & Breakfast.

Airbnb's logo is called the Bélo. Its single line hides a person with open arms, a location pin, a heart and the letter A. To us, though, it was a tube first of all: a tube you could pump full of air.
beats: The logo has sprung a leak and lies wrinkled and flat on a wooden floor
A socked foot works a pump: one, two, three, and each breath of air swells along the Bélo
Fully inflated, the Bélo stands up like a person opening their arms to welcome a guest
It flops backward onto the floor and becomes a bed again
The thud travels outward, and the letters of airbnb puff up one by one and hop
en.summary: Airbnb has millions of listings today. Its very first "bed" was an air mattress on a living room floor.

zh.name: 雀巢 Nestlé
idea: Nestlé 在创始人家乡的德语方言里，意思是“小鸟巢”。创始人 Henri Nestlé 把家族纹章上的一只鸟，改成了一窝鸟：鸟妈妈在巢边喂雏鸟。
有个细节很少人注意：1988 年，logo 里的雏鸟从三只改成了两只，常见的说法是为了更贴近现代家庭。我们想给它一个更温柔的解释：第三只，长大飞走了。
beats: 巢里冒出一枚蛋，孵出第三只雏鸟，头上还顶着半个蛋壳
妈妈低头喂了它一口，它一下子长成了小鸟
它跳上妈妈的头顶，妈妈一低头，背成了滑梯
它顺着妈妈的背滑下去，扑腾几下，第一次飞了起来
它在一家人头顶翻了个筋斗，飞走了，巢里剩下两只，正好是今天的 logo
zh.summary: 养育的终点，是让它离开。logo 里少掉的那只雏鸟，没有消失，它只是长大了。

en.name: Nestlé
idea: In the German dialect of the founder's hometown, Nestlé means "little nest". Founder Henri Nestlé took the single bird on his family coat of arms and turned it into a whole nest: a mother bird at the edge, feeding her chicks.

Here's a detail few people notice. In 1988, the logo went from three chicks to two. The usual explanation is that it better reflects the modern family. We wanted a gentler explanation: the third one grew up and flew away.
beats: An egg appears in the nest and hatches a third chick, half an eggshell still on its head
Mom bends down and feeds it one bite, and it shoots up into a young bird
It hops onto her head, and when she lowers her head, her back becomes a slide
It slides down her back, flaps a few times, and flies for the first time
It does a somersault above the family and flies off, leaving two chicks in the nest, exactly as in today's logo
en.summary: The end of raising a child is letting them leave. The chick missing from the logo is still out there. It just grew up.

zh.name: 百事 Pepsi
idea: 2008 年百事换 logo，设计公司交了一份 27 页的说明文档，把新 logo 和黄金比例、地球磁场、相对论扯在一起，还说百事球有自己的“引力场”。这份文档后来被全网群嘲，成了设计圈的名梗。
我们决定把这句话当真：如果百事球真有引力呢？
beats: logo 跳了一下，PEPSI 五个字母从球面上弹飞
白底铺成电光蓝的网格，镜头倾斜下来，原来这是一颗立体的百事球
球跳起来狠狠砸下，把网格压成一口引力井，角落打出一行图注：FIG. 08 THE PEPSI GRAVITATIONAL PULL
五个字母顺着井壁螺旋转进去，越转越快
井面像蹦床一样回弹，把字母弹回球面，按节拍一个个落位
zh.summary: 当年被群嘲的那份文档，我们认真地给它画了一张图解。设计圈的梗，有时候也值得被好好拍一次。

en.name: Pepsi
idea: When Pepsi changed its logo in 2008, the design firm delivered a 27-page document tying the new logo to the golden ratio, the Earth's magnetic field and the theory of relativity. It even claimed the Pepsi globe had its own "gravitational field". The internet mocked the document endlessly, and it became a famous running joke in the design world.
We decided to take that line seriously. What if the Pepsi globe really did have gravity?
beats: The logo hops, and the five letters of PEPSI fly off the globe
The white background turns into an electric-blue grid. The camera tilts down, and the logo turns out to be a 3D Pepsi globe
The globe leaps up and slams down, pressing the grid into a gravity well, while a caption types out in the corner: FIG. 08 THE PEPSI GRAVITATIONAL PULL
The five letters spiral down the walls of the well, faster and faster
The well springs back like a trampoline and bounces the letters back onto the globe, landing one by one on the beat
en.summary: We made a proper diagram for the document everyone laughed at. Sometimes a design-world joke deserves to be filmed properly.

zh.name: YouTube
idea: YouTube 名字里的 Tube，是英语里对电视的俗称（显像管）。早年的 logo 就是一个红色电视屏幕框住 Tube，后来红色屏幕变成了今天的播放键，圆角的形状仍然像一台老电视。
YouTube 上的第一支视频是 2005 年 4 月 23 日上传的《Me at the zoo》，19 秒，联合创始人站在动物园的大象前面，只说了一句：大象很酷的地方是，它们有非常、非常、非常长的鼻子。
beats: 红色播放键往后长出机身、小腿和天线，变成一台老电视，字母被震得倒在地上
电视开机，播的正是《Me at the zoo》，字幕逐词出现
念到第一、第二个 really，画面里的象鼻各长一截
第三个 really，鼻子穿出屏幕，从倒下的字母底下钻过去，一个个把它们撬起来站好
鼻子嗖地缩回电视，电视关机，变回播放键
zh.summary: 今天每分钟有几百小时的视频上传到 YouTube，而这一切是从 19 秒的大象开始的。那句 really, really, really long，我们帮它演了出来。

en.name: YouTube
idea: The Tube in YouTube is English slang for television, from the old cathode-ray tube. The early logo was a red TV screen framing the word Tube. Later the red screen became today's play button, and its rounded shape still looks like an old TV.

The first video on YouTube was uploaded on April 23, 2005: "Me at the zoo", 19 seconds long. A co-founder stands in front of the elephants at the zoo and says just one thing: the cool thing about elephants is that they have really, really, really long trunks.
beats: The red play button grows a body, stubby legs and antennae out the back and becomes an old TV. The jolt knocks the letters over
The TV switches on, playing "Me at the zoo", with subtitles appearing word by word
On the first and second "really", the elephant's trunk on screen grows a little longer each time
On the third "really", the trunk pokes out of the screen, slides under the fallen letters and pries them up to stand one by one
The trunk whips back into the TV, the TV switches off, and it is the play button again
en.summary: Today hundreds of hours of video are uploaded to YouTube every minute, and it all started with 19 seconds of elephants. We acted out that "really, really, really long" for it.

zh.name: 英特尔 Intel
idea: “灯，等灯等灯”，这五个音几乎人人都听过，是 1994 年起英特尔广告结尾的提示音。
我们盯着 intel 这五个字母看了很久，发现一件事：它们的高低是 i 低、n 低、t 高、e 低、l 最高，正好和那五个音的高低一模一样。字母一个都不用挪，量出来就是一段谱子。
beats: 五根谱线像琴弦一样拉到 logo 上方，画面沉进品牌深蓝
i 蹲一下起跳，把头顶的浅蓝小方块甩上谱表，弦被敲亮，跳出一个字：灯
停一拍，n、t、e、l 依次起跳，各吐出一个方块飞上谱表：等、灯、等、灯，高的音字母也跳得高
整行谱子砸下来，五个音正好落在五个字母的头顶，字母被压下去再弹起
音符钻回字母里，只有 i 上那个弹回原位，又成了那个小方块
zh.summary: Intel Inside 说的是芯片藏在电脑里。原来那段旋律，也一直藏在它的名字里。

en.name: Intel
idea: Almost everyone has heard those five notes. Since 1994 they have closed Intel's ads. Chinese listeners hum them as "dēng, děng dēng děng dēng".

We stared at the five letters of intel for a long time and noticed something. Their heights go i low, n low, t high, e low, l highest, which matches the pitch of those five notes exactly. Without moving a single letter, you can measure a melody off the logo.
beats: Five staff lines stretch over the logo like strings, and the frame sinks into the brand's deep blue
The i crouches and jumps, flinging the light blue square from its head onto the staff. The string lights up as it's struck, and out pops a syllable: dēng
After a one-beat pause, n, t, e and l jump in turn, each spitting a square up onto the staff: děng, dēng, děng, dēng. The letters with higher notes jump higher
The whole line of music crashes down, and the five notes land right on the heads of the five letters, which squash down and bounce back
The notes sink back into the letters. Only the one on the i bounces back into place and becomes that little square again
en.summary: Intel Inside means the chip is hidden inside your computer. Turns out the melody was hidden inside its name all along.

zh.name: Adobe
idea: 用过 Photoshop 的人都认识那圈会动的黑白虚线，选中一块区域，它就沿着边缘不停地爬。中文圈的设计师给它起了个外号：蚂蚁线。
Adobe 1982 年成立，第一个产品 PostScript 开启了桌面出版；后来的 Photoshop 让“P 图”成了一个动词。那就让蚂蚁线变成真的蚂蚁。
beats: logo 被选中，外面一圈蚂蚁线在爬
按下 Delete，红色消失，洞底露出 Photoshop 透明背景的灰白棋盘格
镜头压低，每一段虚线长出腿和触角，原来是一队蚂蚁沿着洞口在走
蚂蚁顶着红色的 A 标零件、扛着 A d o b e 五个字母游行回来，一块块抛回自己的洞里
蚂蚁收腿，变回虚线，Ctrl+D 取消选择，logo 完好如初
zh.summary: 每个设计师都按过无数次 Ctrl+Z。这一次，帮你把东西搬回来的，是那群一直在边上转圈的蚂蚁。

en.name: Adobe
idea: Anyone who has used Photoshop knows that moving black-and-white dashed line. Select an area and it crawls endlessly around the edge. Chinese-speaking designers gave it a nickname: the ant line.
Adobe was founded in 1982. Its first product, PostScript, kicked off desktop publishing. Later, Photoshop made "photoshop" a verb. So we let the ant line turn into real ants.
beats: The logo is selected, and a line of marching ants crawls around it
Delete is pressed. The red disappears, and the bottom of the hole shows Photoshop's gray-and-white transparency checkerboard
The camera drops low. Every dash grows legs and antennae: it is a line of ants walking along the edge of the hole
The ants parade back carrying the red A mark piece by piece, along with the five letters A d o b e, and toss each part back into its own hole
The ants tuck in their legs and become a dashed line again. Ctrl+D deselects, and the logo is as good as new
en.summary: Every designer has pressed Ctrl+Z countless times. This time, the ones carrying everything back for you are the ants that have been circling the edge all along.

zh.name: GitHub
idea: GitHub 的吉祥物叫 Mona，一半是猫，一半是章鱼，叫 Octocat。logo 是黑色圆里一只白色剪影，它的身体从圆的下沿伸了出去。
我们觉得这张图像一张暗视野显微镜照片：黑色的圆形视野里，一只发光的小生物。圆只是窗口，窗外还有它的身体和触手。
beats: 视野光阑打开，黑圆铺满画面，Mona 原来是一只半透明、会发光的微生物，睁眼挥手
Fork：它的脸颊长出一个芽，长成一个完整的自己，拉丝、断开、弹开
Commit：分身身体里一个接一个亮起三个绿色的“+”，顶上的标签跟着从 1 数到 3
Pull request：分身把三个“+”装进一个小囊泡递过去，本尊接住一拽
Merge：两只撞成一只，荡开一圈紫色波纹；光阑收回，又是那个 logo
zh.summary: 开源世界里最日常的四个动作，fork、commit、PR、merge，其实就是一只小生物的分裂、生长和重逢。

en.name: GitHub
idea: GitHub's mascot is Mona, half cat and half octopus, known as the Octocat. The logo is a white silhouette inside a black circle, with its body reaching out past the bottom edge of the circle.
To us it looked like a darkfield microscope photo: a small glowing creature inside a black, round field of view. The circle is only a window. Outside it are the rest of the body and the tentacles.
beats: The field diaphragm opens and the black circle fills the frame. Mona turns out to be a translucent, glowing microorganism. It opens its eyes and waves
Fork: a bud grows from its cheek into a complete copy of itself, stretches into strands, snaps apart and springs away
Commit: three green "+" signs light up one after another inside the copy's body, and the label on top counts from 1 to 3
Pull request: the copy packs the three "+" signs into a small vesicle and passes it over, and the original grabs it and pulls
Merge: the two crash into one, sending out a ring of purple ripples. The diaphragm closes, and it is the logo again
en.summary: The four most everyday moves in open source, fork, commit, PR and merge, are really one small creature splitting, growing and reuniting.

zh.name: OpenAI
idea: OpenAI 的标志是同一段弯折的带子绕着中心转六次，一上一下互相穿过，编成一个结。每一段都压着下一段，又被上一段压着。
而 GPT 这类语言模型做的事，说穿了就是一个词一个词地猜下一个词，每个新词都接在前一个词后面。我们想：如果这个结就是一句话呢？
beats: 五条带子一条接一条缩回槽口，只剩左上那一条，镜头推近
一条纸带边走边印字：every word in this knot
下一条从它底下送出来，接着往下写，词尾停一下，on、at 闪过，最后落定 about
六条纸带一条比一条快，最后一个词也闪过 end、start，落定 first，尾巴钻回第一条底下，结锁上
整句话完整地印在结里：every word in this knot / was a guess about / the next one, made / one word at a time, / until the last word / led back to the first。随后结一拧收紧，字母飞散，停回标准 logo
zh.summary: 这个结没有头也没有尾，就像这支循环的片子。而它讲的，正是 AI 写字的方式：一次猜一个词。

en.name: OpenAI
idea: The OpenAI logo is one bent band that turns around the center six times, weaving over and under itself into a knot. Each segment lies on top of the next and under the one before.
And what language models like GPT do, put simply, is guess the next word, one word at a time, each new word attached to the one before it. We thought: what if this knot is a sentence?
beats: Five bands retract into their slots one after another, leaving only the one at upper left, and the camera pushes in
A paper strip prints words as it moves: every word in this knot
The next strip feeds out from underneath it and keeps writing. At the end of the line it hesitates, on and at flash by, and it settles on about
Each of the six strips runs faster than the last. The final word also flickers through end and start before settling on first, and its tail tucks back under the first strip, locking the knot

The whole sentence is printed inside the knot: every word in this knot / was a guess about / the next one, made / one word at a time, / until the last word / led back to the first. Then the knot twists tight, the letters scatter, and it settles back into the standard logo
en.summary: This knot has no beginning and no end, just like this looping film. And what it describes is how AI writes: one guessed word at a time.

zh.name: Instagram
idea: Instagram 2010 年上线，名字是 instant camera（即时相机）加 telegram（电报）。它养成了一代人的习惯：菜上桌先别动，让相机先吃。
把它的图标从正上方往下看，就是网上被拍得最多的那种照片：一杯拿铁的俯拍。圆环是杯口，小圆点是马卡龙，渐变是黄金时刻的桌面，圆角方框是取景框。
beats: 镜头扎进图标，渐变铺成桌面，圆环长成白瓷杯，圆点落成一颗马卡龙
龟背竹、墨镜、可颂、雏菊依次滑进来摆好，奶缸斜着倒奶，拉出一颗心
一根手指伸进画面，在拉花上点了两下
拉花的心跳出咖啡，变成点赞的大白心，把满桌道具全掀飞
快门一闪，咖啡旋进杯底，镜头退回，只剩最简单的那张照片：logo
zh.summary: 所有精心摆拍的照片，删掉道具、删掉滤镜，最后剩下的就是这个图标。

en.name: Instagram
idea: Instagram launched in 2010. Its name combines instant camera and telegram. It gave a generation a new habit: when the food arrives, don't touch it yet. Let the camera eat first.

Look down at its icon from directly above and you get the most photographed shot online: an overhead latte. The ring is the rim of the cup, the small dot is a macaron, the gradient is a tabletop at golden hour, and the rounded square is the viewfinder.
beats: The camera dives into the icon. The gradient spreads into a tabletop, the ring grows into a white porcelain cup, and the dot lands as a macaron
A monstera leaf, sunglasses, a croissant and a daisy slide in and settle into place. A milk jug tilts and pours, drawing a heart in the foam
A finger reaches into the frame and taps the latte art twice
The heart jumps out of the coffee and becomes the big white Like heart, blasting every prop off the table
The shutter flashes, the coffee swirls down into the cup, and the camera pulls back to the simplest photo of all: the logo
en.summary: Take any carefully staged photo, remove the props, remove the filters, and what's left is this icon.

zh.name: 华为 Huawei
idea: 华为的标志是八片放射状的红色花瓣。任正非说过一句话：烧不死的鸟是凤凰。华为还有一张有名的广告，是二战里弹痕累累却飞了回来的伊尔-2 飞机，配文“没有伤痕累累，哪来皮糙肉厚”。
我们把这八片花瓣看成一只正面张开双翼的鸟。
beats: 左右各四片花瓣当翅膀，鸟从字标上起飞
大火从画面底部烧上来，黑烟吞掉白底，HUAWEI 在火里成了地面
火舌卷住鸟，翅膀被烧黑，它收拢双翼，裹成一枚焦黑的蛋
蛋里心跳三下，裂纹一下比一下亮，四周的火被吸进蛋里
第三下炸开，火和烟被冲散，通红的新羽慢慢冷却成品牌红，落回原位
zh.summary: 大家看惯了这朵“花”。其实它也可以是一只鸟，一只被火烧过、又重新飞起来的鸟。

en.name: Huawei
en.film: The Bird the Fire Couldn't Kill
idea: Huawei's logo is eight red petals radiating outward. Ren Zhengfei once said: a bird that survives the fire is a phoenix. Huawei also ran a famous ad featuring a World War II Il-2 plane riddled with bullet holes that still made it home, with the caption: "Without the scars, you never grow thick skin."
We saw the eight petals as a bird, facing us with its wings spread.
beats: Four petals on each side become wings, and the bird takes off from the wordmark
A huge fire climbs up from the bottom of the frame. Black smoke swallows the white background, and HUAWEI becomes the ground inside the flames
Flames wrap around the bird and scorch its wings black. It folds them in and curls into a charred egg
A heart beats three times inside the egg. The cracks glow brighter with each beat, and the fire around it gets sucked inside
On the third beat it bursts open, blasting away the fire and smoke. Glowing red new feathers slowly cool to the brand's red and settle back into place
en.summary: Everyone is used to seeing this as a flower. It can also be a bird, one that went through fire and flew again.

zh.name: TikTok
idea: 抖音，字面意思就是“抖动的声音”。它的标志是一个黑色音符，旁边错开一道青色和一道红色，很多人以为这是故意做的“故障效果”。
我们换了个解释：这是两盏舞台灯。左上一盏青灯，右下一盏红灯，打在白墙上。只挡住红灯的地方墙是青的，只挡住青灯的地方墙是红的，两盏都挡住就是黑的。音符离墙一步，墙上就是那个 logo。
beats: 场灯暗下，墙上只剩两束追光，一青一红，交叠的地方是白的
音符从墙上跳下来，影子跟着分开、变大、变软
音符卡着节拍左摆、右摆、转一整圈，转到侧面时影子缩成一条线
T i k T o k 一个个离墙，照着领舞的动作一个传一个，全体一起转圈
大家拍回墙面，影子收紧，场灯亮起，只有 o 离墙一点点，所以只有它带着青红边
zh.summary: 那道青红错位不是屏幕坏了，是灯光下跳舞的人留在墙上的影子。这大概就是抖音本来的样子。

en.name: TikTok
idea: TikTok's Chinese name, Douyin, literally means "shaking sound". Its logo is a black musical note with a cyan copy and a red copy offset beside it. Many people assume it's a deliberate glitch effect.

We read it differently: two stage lights. A cyan light at the upper left and a red light at the lower right, both shining on a white wall. Where only the red light is blocked, the wall is cyan. Where only the cyan light is blocked, the wall is red. Where both are blocked, it is black. Put the note one step away from the wall, and the shadow on the wall is the logo.
beats: The house lights go down, leaving two spotlights on the wall, one cyan and one red, white where they overlap
The note jumps off the wall, and its shadows split apart, grow larger and go soft
The note swings left and right on the beat and spins all the way around. Side-on, its shadow shrinks to a thin line
T i k T o k step away from the wall one by one, copying the lead dancer's moves down the line, then all spin together
They all slap back onto the wall, the shadows tighten, and the house lights come up. Only the o stays a hair away from the wall, so it alone keeps its cyan and red edges
en.summary: That cyan-and-red offset is the shadow a dancer leaves on the wall under the lights. Maybe that's what TikTok was all along.

zh.name: 比亚迪 BYD
idea: 2020 年，比亚迪发布了刀片电池，宣传时做了一个针刺试验：钢针扎穿电芯，不起火、不冒烟。
比亚迪的车分两个系列，王朝系列（秦、汉、唐、宋）和海洋系列（海豚、海豹、海鸥）。古代龙袍下摆有一种纹样叫“海水江崖纹”，一圈圈卷起的浪头和平行的水纹。BYD 新字标的红色等宽线条，正好能画出这片海。
beats: 一片画成海水江崖纹的红色海涨上来，吞没了 BYD
风暴起来，三个回卷的浪头一起往前推，浪尖甩出水滴
一根带金箍的钢针从天而降，扎进海心
两道水柱冲起又落回，平静从针的位置向两边推开，满海的浪线一条条变平
水退下去，BYD 浮出水面，针拔出来，留下 Y 中间那一竖
zh.summary: 针刺试验比的是扎下去不起火。在这支片子里，扎下去连海都静了。一根定海神针。

en.name: BYD
en.film: The Pillar That Calms the Sea
idea: In 2020, BYD launched its Blade Battery. To promote it, the company ran a nail penetration test: a steel needle driven straight through a battery cell, with no fire and no smoke.

BYD's cars come in two lines: the Dynasty series (Qin, Han, Tang, Song) and the Ocean series (Dolphin, Seal, Seagull). The hems of ancient Chinese dragon robes carry a pattern of the sea meeting the cliffs: curling wave crests stacked in rows, with parallel lines of water below. The red, even-width strokes of BYD's new wordmark are just right for drawing that sea.
beats: A red sea, drawn in that wave-and-cliff pattern from the dragon robes, rises and swallows BYD
A storm builds. Three curling wave crests surge forward together, flinging droplets from their tips
A steel needle bound with gold bands drops from the sky and plunges into the heart of the sea
Two columns of water shoot up and fall back. Calm spreads outward from the needle, and line by line the waves across the sea go flat
The water recedes and BYD rises to the surface. The needle pulls out and leaves behind the vertical stroke in the middle of the Y
en.summary: In the real nail test, what counts is that the needle goes in and nothing catches fire. In this film, the needle goes in and even the sea goes still, like the gold-banded pillar from Journey to the West that once held the ocean steady.

zh.name: 特斯拉 Tesla
idea: 特斯拉的名字致敬发明交流电系统的尼古拉·特斯拉。马斯克解释过 logo 的来历：T 是电动机的一个横截面，T 的主体是转子上的一个磁极，上面那道弧线是外面定子的一段。
我们量了官方图形，发现这不只是个说法：T 的张角约 45 度，弧线也是 45 度，8 个 T 正好拼满一圈转子，8 段弧正好拼满一圈定子。
beats: 标准 logo 变成一模一样的 3D 件，镜头往后拉
T 和弧线像两条链子从 logo 里反向拉出来，一节一节卡进位置
镜头停在正面：一圈 8 个 T，外面 8 段弧，拼成一台完整的电机
轴插进去，通电，摄影棚的灯“啪”地灭掉，电机把电拽走了
气隙里的光跳一格，转子跟一格，越来越快，最后再生制动，灯亮回来，一切收回成那一片切片
zh.summary: 马斯克说 T 是电机的一片切片。我们把剩下的七片找了回来，让它转了一圈。

en.name: Tesla
idea: Tesla's name honors Nikola Tesla, who invented the alternating current system. Elon Musk has explained where the logo comes from: the T is a cross-section of an electric motor. The main body of the T is one pole on the rotor, and the arc above it is a section of the stator outside.
We measured the official artwork and found this is more than a story. The T spans about 45 degrees, and so does the arc. Eight Ts fill a full ring of rotor, and eight arcs fill a full ring of stator.
beats: The standard logo becomes an identical 3D part, and the camera pulls back
Ts and arcs pull out of the logo in opposite directions like two chains, clicking into place link by link
The camera stops head-on: a ring of eight Ts with eight arcs around it, forming a complete motor
The shaft slides in and the power comes on. The studio lights snap off as the motor drains the power
Light jumps one step around the air gap, and the rotor follows one step, faster and faster. Finally regenerative braking kicks in, the lights come back, and everything folds back into that one slice
en.summary: Musk said the T is one slice of a motor. We found the other seven slices and let it spin.

zh.name: 任天堂 Nintendo
idea: 任天堂 1889 年在京都做花札纸牌起家，名字常被解读为“尽人事，听天命”。它的红色圆角外框从 1970 年代用到今天，形状像一条椭圆跑道，玩家们干脆就叫它“跑道 logo”。
既然大家都这么叫，那就让它真的当一回赛道。
beats: 整个 logo 往后倒成地面，红框升起来变成护栏，Nintendo 八个字母站起来当看台
马里奥和路易吉开着卡丁车从天而降，落进弯道，车身一压一弹
过弯时马里奥漂移，火花从蓝变橙，从地上的 ® 贴花上压过去，出弯小涡轮喷火
下直道上两车并排，看台上的字母挨个跳起来打人浪，马里奥切内线超车
冲过方格终点门，马里奥举拳，字母一起欢呼，然后依次坐回地面，护栏放平，变回 logo
zh.summary: 很多人小时候第一次握手柄，就是在赛道上。一个画了几十年的红框，原来一直是一条跑道。

en.name: Nintendo
idea: Nintendo started in Kyoto in 1889 making hanafuda playing cards. Its name is often read as "do your best, and leave the rest to heaven". Its red rounded frame has been in use since the 1970s. The shape looks like an oval racetrack, so players simply call it the racetrack logo.
Since everyone calls it that, we let it actually be a racetrack.
beats: The whole logo tips back to become the ground. The red frame rises into guardrails, and the eight letters of Nintendo stand up to become the grandstand
Mario and Luigi drop from the sky in their karts and land in a corner, the karts squashing down and bouncing up
Mario drifts through the turn, sparks shifting from blue to orange, rolls over the ® decal on the ground, and fires a mini-turbo out of the corner
On the straight the two karts run side by side, the letters in the grandstand do the wave one after another, and Mario cuts inside to overtake
They cross the checkered finish gate. Mario pumps his fist and the letters cheer, then sit back down one by one, the guardrails fold flat, and it is the logo again
en.summary: For many people, the first time they held a controller as a kid, they were on a racetrack. A red frame drawn for decades was a racetrack all along.

zh.name: 腾讯 QQ
idea: 1999 年 2 月，腾讯推出了一款叫 OICQ 的聊天软件，第二年改名叫 QQ。它的图标是一只黑身白肚、黄嘴黄脚、围着红围巾的小企鹅，从早期一直用到今天，腾讯也因此被大家叫成“鹅厂”。
可对很多人来说，这只企鹅最熟悉的样子不是大图标，而是电脑屏幕右下角那个小小的托盘图标：它一闪一闪，伴着“嘀嘀嘀”，就是有人来找你了。这支片子就让它先躲回右下角，再从那里跳出来见你。
beats: 企鹅眨着一只眼站好，睁开眼一蹲，一跃跳进屏幕右下角，缩成任务栏里的一个小图标。
半天没人找，它慢慢变灰、闭上眼，打起了瞌睡，头顶冒出一串 Z。
嘀、嘀、嘀，消息来了：小企鹅一下惊醒，变回彩色，在托盘里一闪一跳。
鼠标赶过来连点两下，企鹅蹦出托盘，顺手把鼠标撞飞，先跳上任务栏站稳。
再用力一跃，镜头往后拉，它越跳越大，落在画面正中，围巾一甩，冲你眨了下眼，又是那只 QQ 企鹅。
zh.summary: 那些年，右下角那只一闪一闪的企鹅，意味着有人在想你。二十多年过去，它还守在那里，等着下一声“嘀嘀嘀”。

en.name: Tencent QQ
idea: In February 1999 Tencent launched a chat app called OICQ, renamed QQ the following year. Its icon, a little black-and-white penguin with a yellow beak, yellow feet and a red scarf, has stayed with it ever since, and people in China still nickname Tencent "the Goose Factory" (the Chinese word for penguin ends in "goose").

But for a whole generation the penguin they remember best is the tiny one in the bottom-right corner of the screen. When it started blinking, to a "di-di-di", someone was looking for you. So this film sends the penguin back to that corner and lets it jump out to meet you.
beats: The penguin stands winking, opens its eye, crouches and leaps into the bottom-right corner, shrinking into a tiny icon on the taskbar.
Nobody writes. It slowly turns grey, closes its eyes and dozes off, a trail of Z's drifting up.
Di, di, di: a message. The little penguin wakes with a start, its colour comes back, and it blinks and bounces in the tray.
The cursor rushes over and double-clicks. The penguin springs out of the tray, knocks the cursor flying and lands on top of the taskbar.
One more big jump: the camera pulls back, the penguin grows as it flies, lands dead centre, flicks its scarf and winks at you. The QQ penguin again.
en.summary: Back then, a penguin blinking in the corner of the screen meant someone was thinking of you. More than twenty years on it is still there, waiting for the next di-di-di.

zh.name: Kimi 月之暗面
idea: Kimi 是月之暗面（Moonshot AI）在 2023 年 10 月推出的 AI 助手。公司 2023 年在北京成立，中文名取自 Pink Floyd 的专辑《The Dark Side of the Moon》；英文名 Moonshot 原本是“登月”，后来也用来指那种近乎不可能、却值得全力一搏的大目标。Kimi 的图标是一块黑色圆角方块，中间一个白色的 K，右上角挂着一颗蓝点，很多人把它看成 K 旁边升起的一个小月亮。仔细看，蓝点的左下角是方的，又像一个小小的对话气泡。
我们在 K 身上看到了一把弹弓：它往右张开的 V 口，正好是弹弓的叉。公司既然叫 Moonshot，那就真的射一次月亮。
beats: K 的两个叉尖各弹出一根蓝色皮筋，一把兜住右上角的蓝点，蓝点的方角一缩，变成一颗圆球。
皮筋把球拽进 V 口，再一路往后拉过整个 K，拉到图标最左边。K 的两只叉被拽得往回弯，整块图标也被拽歪了，拉满以后还在发抖。
一松手，球从 V 口射了出去。皮筋弹过头，来回抖几下，缩回叉尖，图标往后一坐。
球绕着图标飞了一圈。转到背后的时候，黑色方块把它整个挡住，只看见方块边缘透出一圈蓝光，像一次小小的月食。这几帧就是真正的“月之暗面”。
它从另一边绕出来，冲着镜头从 K 的前面掠过。这时候它离我们最近，看得见月面上的阴影，K 的下腿也被它的引力扯了一下。
最后它落回右上角，压扁、弹一下，左下角重新变方，又是那个带着小尾巴的气泡。K 被撞得一颤，标准 logo 停住。
zh.summary: 很多人第一次用 Kimi，是把一整本书、一沓论文丢给它，等它读完回一句话。登月本是件不可能的事，而这颗蓝点，就像每次射出去、又带着答案落回来的那个小月亮。

en.name: Kimi
idea: Kimi is the AI assistant that Moonshot AI launched in October 2023. The company was founded in Beijing that same year, and its Chinese name, Yue Zhi An Mian ("the dark side of the moon"), comes from Pink Floyd's album The Dark Side of the Moon. Its English name, Moonshot, once meant a flight to the moon and now means a goal so ambitious it is almost impossible, but worth everything you have. Kimi's icon is a black rounded square with a white K and a blue dot in the top right corner, which many people read as a little moon rising beside the K. Look closely and the dot's lower left corner is square, so it is also a tiny speech bubble.
We saw a slingshot in the K: the V that opens to the right is exactly the fork of one. With a company called Moonshot, it had to fire a real shot at the moon.
beats: Two blue rubber bands spring out of the K's fork tips and scoop up the blue dot. Its square corner rounds off and it becomes a ball.

The bands drag the ball into the V, then haul it back across the whole K to the far left of the icon. Both prongs bend back under the strain, the whole icon gets pulled askew, and at full stretch everything trembles.
Let go, and the ball shoots out through the V. The bands overshoot, wobble and snap back into the fork tips, and the icon kicks back.

The ball flies once around the icon. When it passes behind, the black square hides it completely and only a blue rim of light glows around the edges, like a tiny eclipse. For those few frames it really is the dark side of the moon.
It swings out the other side and sweeps past the front of the K, straight at the camera. This close you can see the shadows on its surface, and its pull tugs at the K's lower leg.

At last it drops back into the top right corner, squashes, bounces, and its lower left corner turns square again: the little speech bubble is back. The K shudders from the hit and the standard logo holds.
en.summary: For many people, the first thing they did with Kimi was hand it a whole book or a stack of papers and wait for one answer. Reaching the moon used to be the impossible thing. This blue dot is the little moon that gets fired off every time and comes back carrying the answer.

zh.name: 多邻国 Duolingo
idea: 多邻国 2011 年在匹兹堡创立，想让每个人都能免费学一门语言。它的吉祥物 Duo 是一只绿色猫头鹰，比课程还出名的是它“催学”的本事：连续打卡一断，Duo 的提醒就追过来，网上全是“Duo 拿着家伙在你家门口等你”的段子。
这支片子假设：duolingo 里 i 上那个绿点，就是 Duo 本鸟。它一直蹲在那儿，盯着另外几个字母好好学习。
beats: 字母们犯困了：打个哈欠，东倒西歪，o 滚到一边，l 靠在 o 身上，颜色褪成“还没解锁”的灰，头顶冒出 Zz。只有 i 还站得笔直。
i 上那个绿点抖了两下，蹦起来，在半空中鼓成 Duo，长出耳羽、眼睛、翅膀和脚，一屁股落在 i 上。
Duo 左看看右看看，一地睡着的字母。眉毛一压，深吸一口气。
一声大吼。字母按离它的远近一个接一个被吓得跳起来，在空中转正、变回绿色，落地站好。
Duo 满意地眯眼笑了，跳起来越缩越小，变回 i 上那个点。logo 恢复原样，它还在那儿盯着。
zh.summary: 很多人能把一门语言坚持学下去，靠的就是这只一点都不肯放过你的绿鸟。下次看到 duolingo 这个词，记得 i 上那个点正看着你。

en.name: Duolingo
en.film: Keeping an Eye on the i
idea: Duolingo was founded in Pittsburgh in 2011 to let anyone learn a language for free. Its mascot, Duo, is a green owl, and it is famous for one thing even more than the lessons: nagging. Break your streak and Duo's reminders come after you, and the internet is full of jokes about Duo waiting outside your door.
This film imagines that the green dot on the i in duolingo is Duo himself, perched there all along, making sure the other letters do their lessons.
beats: The letters get sleepy. They yawn and slump, an o rolls off to one side, the l leans on its neighbour, they fade to locked-lesson grey and little Zs float up. Only the i stays standing.
The dot on the i shivers, hops into the air and puffs up into Duo, sprouting ear tufts, eyes, wings and feet, and lands on top of the i.
Duo looks left, then right, at a floor full of sleeping letters. The brows come down. He takes a deep breath.
One big squawk. Letter by letter, starting with the closest, they leap up in fright, straighten out in mid-air, turn green again and land back in line.
Duo squints happily, hops up, shrinks smaller and smaller and drops back into place as the dot on the i. The logo is back, and he is still watching.
en.summary: Plenty of people stuck with a new language because a green owl would not let them off the hook. Next time you see the word duolingo, remember the dot on the i is watching.

zh.name: DeepSeek 深度求索
idea: DeepSeek 2023 年在杭州成立，中文名叫“深度求索”。它的 logo 是一头蓝色的鲸鱼，鲸鱼能潜到很深的海里去找东西，正好对上“深度”和“求索”这两个词。2025 年初开源的 DeepSeek-R1 会在回答之前，先把自己的思考过程一段段写出来：嗯……等等……换个角度试试……很多人就是在这里第一次看到 AI 是怎么想问题的。
这支片子把那段思考过程当成一片海，越往下越深。名字沉下去了，鲸鱼就潜下去，把它一个字母一个字母找回来。
beats: deepseek 八个字母一个接一个蹦起来，掉进 logo 下面刚展开的“思考中…”，沉进一行行思考的文字里。
鲸鱼往后一仰，尾巴一甩，一头扎下去。文字像水一样被它挤开，又晃着合拢，底色从纸白一路变成深海蓝。
八个字母卡在不同深度的句子里。鲸鱼经过一个就叼出一个，让它们排成一串跟在身后。
最深的地方是最后一句“好，我想到了。”鲸鱼在这里掉头，身后那串字母刚好连成 deepseek。
往回游的时候，整段思考从下往上一行行收起来，最后只剩一行“已深度思考（用时 4 秒）”，海水也跟着变浅。
鲸鱼冲出水面，翻个身落回原位，字母从 k 到 d 一个个飞回去，又是那个标准的 logo。
zh.summary: 很多人喜欢 DeepSeek，是因为第一次看见 AI 在认真地想。想得越深，找回来的答案越踏实。

en.name: DeepSeek
idea: DeepSeek was founded in Hangzhou in 2023. Its Chinese name means roughly "seeking in the depths", and its logo is a blue whale, an animal that dives deep to find what it is after. DeepSeek-R1, open-sourced in early 2025, writes out its reasoning before it answers: hmm... wait... let me try another angle... For a lot of people, that was the first time they watched an AI think.
This film treats that reasoning as an ocean that gets darker the deeper you go. The name sinks into it, and the whale dives down to bring it back, one letter at a time.
beats: The eight letters of deepseek hop up one by one and drop into the "Thinking..." panel unrolling below the logo, sinking between lines of reasoning.
The whale rears back, flicks its tail and plunges in. The text parts around it like water and sways shut behind it, while the page fades from white to deep-sea blue.
The letters are stuck in sentences at different depths. Each time the whale swims past one, it plucks it out, and they line up in its wake.
At the very bottom sits the last line: "OK, I've got it." The whale turns there, and the string of letters behind it spells deepseek.
On the way up, the reasoning folds away line by line from the bottom until only "Thought for 4 seconds" is left, and the water grows shallow again.
The whale breaks the surface, rolls back into its spot, and the letters fly home from k to d. The standard logo is back.
en.summary: Part of what drew people to DeepSeek was seeing an AI actually think things through. The deeper it goes, the more solid the answer it comes back with.

zh.name: Google Gemini
idea: Gemini 是 Google DeepMind 的大模型，2023 年 12 月发布。名字是拉丁语里的“双子”，有两层意思：一层是 Google Brain 和 DeepMind 两个团队合成了一个；另一层是向 NASA 的双子座计划致敬。那是阿波罗登月之前的双人飞船，1966 年，双子座 8 号在轨道上完成了人类第一次太空对接。
所以这支片子把那颗四角星沿中线拆成两艘飞船，让它们自己飞上太空，在地球上空对接成一颗。
beats: 星星沿中线“咔”地裂成两半，左边是红黄绿的暖色，右边是蓝色，像两艘并排待发的飞船。
两半的底尖同时点火升空，字标跟着地面掉出画面，天从白变蓝再变黑，两道尾迹在蓝天里拉成白线。
发动机关机入轨，地球的弧线从画面下方露出来。两半各自歪着、高低错开，一下一下喷出白色气团修正姿态，慢慢靠拢。
“哐”的一声接上，回弹一下再锁紧，接缝亮了一下就消失了。两半合成一整颗星，转过来正对镜头。
整颗星掉头冲回大气层，下沿烧出一圈火光，一头扎进云层，画面重新变白。
字标从下面升回原位，星星从上方落进自己的位置，弹了两下，Gemini 几个字母被震得依次跳了一下。
zh.summary: 两个团队合成一个，两艘飞船接成一艘。今天这颗星亮在无数个对话框里，做的还是同一件事：把两头接到一起。

en.name: Google Gemini
idea: Gemini is Google DeepMind's large model, launched in December 2023. The name is Latin for "twins", and it carries two meanings: Google Brain and DeepMind merging into one team, and a nod to NASA's Project Gemini, the two-person spacecraft that came before the Moon landings. In 1966, Gemini 8 performed the first docking of two spacecraft in orbit.
So this film splits the four-pointed star down the middle into two spacecraft, flies them into orbit, and lets them dock into one star above the Earth.
beats: The star cracks down its centre line into two halves, warm red, yellow and green on the left, blue on the right, like two craft waiting side by side on the pad.
Both halves light their engines and lift off. The wordmark drops away with the ground, the sky turns from white to blue to black, and two contrails stretch out behind them.
Engines cut, orbit reached, and the curve of the Earth rises into view. The halves drift in, tilted and out of line, firing little white thruster puffs to straighten up and close the gap.
Contact. A clunk, a small rebound, the latches catch. The seam flares once and disappears, and the two halves are one star, turning to face the camera.
The star turns back toward the planet, its lower edges glowing with re-entry heat, and plunges through the clouds until the frame is white again.
The wordmark rises back into place, the star drops into its spot and bounces twice, and the letters of Gemini hop one after another from the impact.
en.summary: Two teams became one, and two spacecraft became one. Today the star sits in countless chat boxes, still doing the same job: bringing two ends together.

zh.name: Hugging Face 抱抱脸
idea: Hugging Face 2016 年在纽约起步，最早做的是一个陪青少年聊天的机器人 App，公司名字直接取自 🤗 这个“拥抱”表情。后来它开源了 Transformers 库，成了开源 AI 的大本营，可 logo 一直没换：还是那张张开双手的笑脸。
仔细看，这个 logo 的排法就像一条聊天消息：左边是头像，右边是一句话。那就让它回到聊天框里，有人发来一个难过的表情，它不打字，直接从屏幕里探出来，抱你一下。
beats: 标准 logo 停了一下，字标外面鼓起一个灰色气泡，整个 logo 变成了一条聊天消息，🤗 就是头像。
右下角弹进来一条深色消息，是一个难过的小表情，眼泪顺着脸往下流，聊天记录往上一推。
🤗 转头看了它一眼，蹲下蓄力，从头像的位置一跃而起，张开双手，朝屏幕外的你扑过来。
它越飞越近，大到占满整个画面，两只手从两边合拢，紧紧抱住屏幕，脸都红了，还在你背上拍了两下。
松开以后它跳回头像的位置，落地一压，字母跟着弹了一下；那个难过的小表情已经笑了，冒出一颗红心。
两个气泡收了回去，聊天框散掉，画面停回标准的 Hugging Face logo。
zh.summary: 它从陪人聊天起家，后来把无数模型分享给所有人，名字里一直留着那个拥抱。对很多人来说，它就是 AI 世界里最先朝你张开手的那一个。

en.name: Hugging Face
idea: Hugging Face started in New York in 2016 as a chatbot app that kept teenagers company, and the company took its name straight from the 🤗 emoji. It later open-sourced the Transformers library and became the home of open-source AI, but the logo never changed: the same smiling face with its arms held open.

Look closely and the lockup reads like a chat message, an avatar on the left and a line of text on the right. So the film puts it back in a chat: someone sends a sad face, and instead of typing a reply, it climbs out of the screen to give you a hug.
beats: The logo holds for a moment, then a grey bubble swells around the wordmark and the whole logo becomes a chat message, with 🤗 as the avatar.
A dark message pops in at the bottom right: a sad little face with a tear rolling down, and the conversation scrolls up.
🤗 turns to look at it, crouches, and springs out of its avatar spot, arms wide, leaping toward you on the other side of the screen.
It keeps coming until it fills the frame, then both hands close in from the sides and squeeze the screen tight. It blushes and gives you two pats on the back.
It lets go and hops back into the avatar spot, landing with a squash that bounces the letters. The sad face is smiling now, and a red heart floats up.
Both bubbles shrink away, the chat disappears, and the frame settles back on the standard Hugging Face logo.
en.summary: It began as a friend to chat with, went on to share countless models with everyone, and kept the hug in its name the whole way. For a lot of people it is the first thing in AI that opens its arms to them.

zh.name: Perplexity
idea: Perplexity 2022 年在旧金山创立，名字取自语言模型里的一个指标“困惑度”，用来衡量模型对下一个词有多意外。这家公司偏偏是来给人解开困惑的：你问一个问题，它去网上找资料、写出答案，每句话后面都标上来源的小角标 [1][2][3]。它的标志由一根根细线搭成，有人看成一本打开的书，有人看成一颗星。
我们在里面看到了另一样东西：左右两边像一对方括号，中间一竖像个 1，合起来正是它答案里随处可见的那个 [1]。所以这支片子让一个困惑的问号被两边的方括号一夹，掰直成 1，再撑开成 Perplexity 的标志。
beats: 标准 logo 先散开：字母往下掉，线条收拢，中间那一竖卷成一个问号，问号的点从底下掉出来。
问号踩在自己的点上左右摇晃，像歪着头在想问题。
一对方括号从两边滑进来，顿了一下，猛地一夹：问号先被关进 [?]，钩子顺势被甩直，点被吸进竖线，变成了 1。
[1] 停住，竖线像被敲过的金属棒一样颤了几下。
1 的小旗翻上去并进竖线，竖线往上下弹长；下面两片像伞一样啪地撑开，把方括号顶到两边，方括号的上沿被拉成一道横梁；最后上面两只三角弹了起来。
镜头拉远，perplexity 几个字母从下面一个接一个跳回来，落在基线上，停成标准 logo。
zh.summary: 我们每天带着一堆问号去问它，它把问号掰直，再给每句话标上出处。从困惑到答案，中间隔着的就是一个 [1]。

en.name: Perplexity
idea: Perplexity was founded in San Francisco in 2022. Its name comes from a language-model metric, perplexity, which measures how surprised a model is by the next word. The company exists to do the opposite for people: you ask a question, it searches the web, writes an answer, and tags every sentence with a small citation, [1][2][3]. Its mark is built from thin lines; some see an open book, others a star.

We saw something else in it: the two sides look like a pair of square brackets, and the line down the middle looks like a 1. Put together, it is the [1] that follows every answer. So in this film a puzzled question mark gets clamped between two brackets, snaps straight into a 1, and the [1] then springs open into the Perplexity mark.
beats: The logo comes apart: the letters drop away, the lines fold in, and the middle line curls into a question mark whose dot falls out the bottom.
The question mark balances on its own dot and rocks from side to side, as if tilting its head in thought.
A pair of brackets slides in from the edges, pauses, then clamps shut: the question mark is caught inside [?], its hook whips straight, the dot is pulled into the stem, and it becomes a 1.
The [1] holds still while the stem rings for a moment like a struck metal rod.

The flag of the 1 flips up into the stem, which shoots up and down; the two lower panels snap open like an umbrella and push the brackets out to the sides, stretching their tops into a crossbar; finally the two triangles on top pop up.
The camera pulls back as the letters of perplexity hop up from below one by one, land on the baseline and settle into the standard logo.
en.summary: We bring it our question marks every day. It straightens them out and shows where every sentence came from. Between confusion and an answer, there is a [1].

zh.name: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili
idea: 哔哩哔哩 2009 年上线，最早叫 Mikufans，2010 年改名 bilibili，名字取自动画《某科学的超电磁炮》里御坂美琴的外号“Biri Biri”，也就是放电时噼里啪啦的声音。它最出名的是弹幕：观众的评论从右往左飞过画面，一个人看视频，也像和一屋子人坐在同一间放映厅里。左边那台长着两根天线的“小电视”是它的吉祥物。
仔细看右边的 BiliBili 字标：i 和 l 都是一根根圆角竖条，B 是两个圆头方框叠起来的，形状正好像一条条弹幕。那就让满屏弹幕被小电视 biri 一下电住，掉下来拼成它的名字。
beats: 一开场，BiliBili 的每一笔都翻身躺平，变回一条条弹幕，从小电视头顶呼啸着往左飞走，小电视缩着脖子眯起眼。
小电视蹦到画面中间，新的弹幕从右边涌进来：“来了来了”“awsl”“2333333”“(゜-゜)つロ 干杯~”，飘到“哈哈哈哈哈哈”时它笑弯了眼，跟着蹦了好几下。
一条粉色的“前方高能！！！”冲进来，小电视瞪大眼睛、天线竖直，全身绷紧。
biri！两根天线放出电弧，打中屏幕上每一条弹幕，所有弹幕一下子定在半空，跟着发抖。
电一停，弹幕全掉了下来。闲聊的弹幕翻着跟头掉出画面，小电视一跃跳回原位。
被选中的弹幕一边往下掉，字一边褪掉：长条竖起来落成 i 和 l，带框的弹幕两两叠成 B，四条最短的弹幕最后叮叮叮叮落成 i 上面的点。
小电视眨一下眼，画面停在标准的哔哩哔哩 logo 上。
zh.summary: B 站的名字是一声 biri，B 站的样子是满屏弹幕。这个 logo 本来就是大家一句一句刷出来的。

en.name: Bilibili
