idea: Bilibili launched in 2009 as Mikufans and became bilibili in 2010. The name comes from Biri Biri, the nickname of Mikoto Misaka in the anime A Certain Scientific Railgun, which is the crackle of an electric spark. The site is famous for danmaku: viewer comments that fly across the video from right to left, so watching alone feels like sitting in a full theatre. The little TV with two antennas on the left is its mascot.

Look closely at the BiliBili wordmark: every i and l is a rounded bar, and each B is two round-ended boxes stacked together, shaped just like comments on screen. So the little TV zaps a screen full of flying comments, and they drop down to spell its name.
beats: The film opens with every stroke of BiliBili tipping over, turning back into a comment and whooshing left over the little TV, which ducks and squeezes its eyes shut.

The TV hops to the middle of the frame as new comments pour in from the right: "here it comes", "awsl", "2333333", "(゜-゜)つロ cheers~". When a line of "hahahahaha" drifts past, it laughs and bounces along.
A pink "High energy ahead!!!" warning rushes in. The TV's eyes go wide and its antennas stand straight up.
Biri! Sparks leap from both antennas to every comment on screen, and they all freeze in mid-air, trembling.
The current cuts out and everything falls. The chatter tumbles out of the frame while the TV jumps back to its spot.

The chosen comments shake off their words as they drop: long bars stand up as the i's and l's, the boxed comments stack two by two into B's, and the four shortest comments land last as the dots, tink tink tink tink.
The TV blinks, and the frame settles on the standard bilibili logo.
en.summary: Bilibili's name is the sound of a spark, and its face is a screen full of comments. This logo was written by everyone, one comment at a time.

zh.name: 大疆 DJI
idea: 大疆 2006 年在深圳创立。创始人汪滔那时还是香港科技大学的学生，做的是直升机的飞控。公司名取自“大志无疆”。2013 年推出的“精灵”Phantom，让航拍第一次飞进了普通人手里。
航拍能拍得稳，靠的是大疆的看家本领：云台。机身再怎么晃、怎么转，挂在下面的相机都稳稳不动，拍出来的画面就像钉在空中。
这支片子就把 dji 字标当成那台相机，挂到一架无人机的云台上，让飞机带着它飞一套特技。飞机翻得底朝天，字标一点没歪。
beats: 开头是标准的 dji 字标。一架折叠着的无人机从画面上方掉下来，四条机臂在半空中“咔”地展开，桨叶转起来，飞机急刹，悬停在字标上方。
机腹下的云台伸出两条臂，从上往下合拢，夹住字标的两头。字标被提起来，从纸面上长出了厚度。
无人机一个急冲，接着绕着字标横滚一整圈：先翻到左边，再钻到下面，又绕到右边，最后回到头顶。飞机底朝天的时候，字标还是端端正正。
一阵大风横扫过来，机身被吹得左摇右晃，字标钉在空中一动不动。飞机又在原地转了一圈，把字标送回原来的位置。
字标落回纸面，重新变平。云台松开收起，无人机拉升飞出画面，留下的还是那个一模一样的 dji。
zh.summary: 大疆真正厉害的，不只是能飞多高，而是飞得再野，镜头里的世界都是稳的。很多人第一次拍出不晃的视频，靠的就是这份看不见的平衡。

en.name: DJI
idea: DJI was founded in Shenzhen in 2006. Its founder, Wang Tao, was still a student at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, working on flight controllers for helicopters. The Chinese name, Dajiang, comes from a phrase that means big ambitions know no borders. In 2013 the Phantom put aerial filming in ordinary people's hands for the first time.
What keeps that footage smooth is DJI's signature trick, the gimbal. However much the aircraft shakes or turns, the camera hanging below it stays perfectly still, so the shot looks pinned in mid-air.
So this film treats the dji wordmark as that camera. A drone hangs it on its gimbal and takes it through a stunt routine. The drone ends up upside down. The logo never tilts.
beats: It opens on the standard dji wordmark. A folded drone drops in from the top of the frame, snaps its four arms open in mid-air, spins up its propellers and brakes to a hover above the logo.
Two gimbal arms swing down from under the drone and clamp both ends of the wordmark. The logo lifts off the page and grows a third dimension.
The drone darts off, then barrel-rolls all the way around the logo: out to the left, underneath, up the right side and back on top. Even with the drone upside down, the logo stays perfectly level.
A gust tears across the frame and throws the drone around, but the logo hangs dead still. The drone spins once on the spot and carries the logo back to where it started.
The wordmark settles back onto the page and goes flat again. The gimbal lets go and folds away, the drone climbs out of frame, and the same dji is left exactly where it was.
en.summary: DJI's real feat isn't how high it flies. It's that however wild the flight, the world in the shot stays steady. For a lot of people, their first video without a shake came from that invisible balancing act.

zh.name: Android 安卓
idea: 2007 年，设计师 Irina Blok 要给 Android 画一个吉祥物。她的灵感来自一个人人都见过、却没人多看一眼的地方：厕所门上那对男女小人。圆脑袋、方身子、胳膊腿各自分开，她给它加上两根天线、涂成绿色，小绿机器人就这样诞生了。后来它以开放授权发布，谁都能拿去改、去画，跟 Android 本身开源的脾气一模一样。2023 年的新 logo 只留下它的脑袋，像是从一条线后面探出头来。
这支片子就把它的出身演一遍：小绿人原本只是门牌上那个男生图标，有一天它长出了天线。
beats: logo 先缩下去，躲进自己脚下那条线里，线一合上，一块蓝色的洗手间门牌从天而降，四颗螺丝一颗颗拧紧。
门牌上的男生小人头顶“啵”地冒出两根天线，旁边的女生小人吓得一蹦。
从头到脚一节一节变绿：圆脑袋压扁成半圆，身子、胳膊、腿依次变成机器人的样子，眼睛也睁开了。
它转头看看隔壁，女生小人朝它挥手道别。
它蹲下一使劲，翻着跟头跳出门牌，四颗螺丝被蹬飞，门牌连着挥手的女生一起掉了下去。
它越飞越近，一头扎进画面中间那条线，身子沉下去，线荡开两道波纹，然后收回成脑袋底下那条平边。
天线晃两下，眨一下眼，停在今天的 Android logo 上。
zh.summary: 一个谁都能用的门牌小人，变成了一个谁都能改的机器人，现在它就在全世界几十亿部手机里。

en.name: Android
idea: In 2007 designer Irina Blok was asked to draw a mascot for Android. She found it somewhere everyone has seen and nobody looks at twice: the little man and woman on restroom doors. A round head, a boxy body, arms and legs set slightly apart. She added two antennae, painted it green, and the robot was born. It was released under an open license, so anyone could redraw and remix it, which is exactly how Android itself works. The 2023 logo keeps only the head, as if the robot were peeking up from behind a line.
This film acts out where it came from: the robot starts life as the man on a restroom sign, until one day he sprouts antennae.
beats: The logo ducks down into the line beneath it, the line zips shut, and a blue restroom sign drops in from above, its four screws twisting in one by one.
Two antennae pop out of the man's head on the sign, and the woman next to him jumps in surprise.
He turns green from the top down: the round head flattens into a dome, then the body, arms and legs become the robot's, and his eyes open.
He glances next door, and the woman waves goodbye.
He crouches and cartwheels out of the sign, kicking all four screws loose, and the sign falls away with the woman still waving.
He grows as he flies toward us and dives into the line in the middle of the frame. His body sinks out of sight, two ripples run along the line, and it pulls back into the flat edge under his head.
The antennae wobble, he blinks once, and he settles into today's Android logo.
en.summary: A figure anyone could use became a robot anyone could remix, and today it lives in billions of phones.

zh.name: 沃尔沃 Volvo
idea: Volvo 是拉丁语，意思是“我滚动”。这个名字最早是瑞典轴承公司 SKF 注册的，滚珠轴承本来就是一圈一圈滚的东西；1927 年，第一辆沃尔沃在哥德堡下线，这个名字就跟着上了车。车标上的圆圈加右上角的斜箭头，是古代代表“铁”的符号，用来讲瑞典钢铁的结实。
“滚”，加上“铁”，再加上一个圆环，这不就是小时候玩的滚铁环吗？那支从圆圈缺口里斜着伸出去的箭头，正好是推铁环的那根铁钩。
beats: 箭头从圆圈的缺口里抽出来，往后一扬，再“当”地一推，铁环滚了出去，圈里的五个字母一下全摔到了底下。
脚下长出一片瑞典的夏天：杉树林、白桦、湖边的红房子、斜着搭的木栅栏。铁环顺着山坡越滚越快，铁钩跟在后面一下一下地推，圆圈上的缺口跟着转了一圈又一圈。
坡底有个小土包，铁环一下飞上了天，把铁钩甩在了身后，圈里的字母也跟着飘了起来。
铁环重重落地，弹了一下，树上的鸟全被惊飞；铁钩赶紧扑上去，重新把它勾住。
铁钩往回带，铁环慢下来，圆圈上的缺口转到铁钩底下，“咔”地卡住，铁环一下停稳。
风景收了下去，地平线缩回铁环脚下，字母一个接一个跳回中间站好，又是沃尔沃的标志。
zh.summary: 一个叫“我滚动”的名字，一个代表“铁”的符号，拼在一起刚好是小时候的滚铁环。它一路滚得飞快，还飞了一回，最后被稳稳勾住、停在原地。很多人信沃尔沃，大概就是信这个：跑得动，也停得住。

en.name: Volvo
idea: Volvo is Latin for “I roll”. The name was first registered by the Swedish bearing maker SKF, and ball bearings are made to roll round and round; in 1927 the first Volvo car rolled out in Gothenburg and took the name with it. The badge, a circle with an arrow at its upper right, is the ancient symbol for iron, there to speak for the strength of Swedish steel.

Put “roll” and “iron” together with a ring and you get an old playground game: an iron hoop driven along with a hooked stick. The arrow leaning out of the gap in the ring sits exactly where that stick would be.
beats: The arrow slides out of the gap in the ring, draws back and gives it a sharp push. The hoop rolls off, and the five letters inside tumble to the bottom.

A Swedish summer rises around it: spruce forest, birches, a red cottage by a lake, a slanted rail fence. The hoop picks up speed down the hill with the stick tapping it along behind, the gap in the ring coming round again and again.
A bump at the bottom launches the hoop into the air and leaves the stick behind, and the letters float up inside the ring.
The hoop lands hard and bounces, scaring the birds out of the trees, and the stick lunges after it and hooks it again.
The stick holds it back, the hoop slows, and as the gap comes round under the stick it drops in with a clack and the hoop stops dead.
The landscape sinks away, the ground line shrinks back under the hoop, and the letters hop back into the middle one by one. It is the Volvo badge again.
en.summary: A name that means “I roll” and a sign that means iron add up to a child’s hoop and stick. It races downhill, takes flight, and still ends up caught and standing perfectly still. That may be what people trust in a Volvo: it goes, and it stops when it should.

zh.name: 维基百科 Wikipedia
idea: 2001 年，Jimmy Wales 和 Larry Sanger 创办了维基百科：一部免费的、任何人都能编辑的百科全书。它由非营利的维基媒体基金会运营，三百多种语言的条目全靠世界各地的志愿者一笔一笔写出来，靠读者的捐款维持运转。
它的 logo 是一颗拼图拼成的地球，每块拼图上印着一种文字的字符：拉丁字母 W、希腊字母 Ω、西里尔字母 И、汉字“維”……顶上故意缺了几块，意思是这部百科永远没有写完。
说到底，这颗球是靠这些文字撑起来的。这支片子就让字离开一会儿，看看球会怎么样。
beats: 球正面的九个字一个接一个从拼图上揭下来，从薄薄的一层印刷长成立体的黑字，在空中翻个跟头，跳到地上前后错落地站好。
球上只剩边缘几个小字，一颗几乎光秃秃的白球悬在半空。它抖了一下，掉了下来。
字们一齐抬头：W 跳起来一头把球顶住，球和 W 都被撞得一扁，И 接着把它顶向另一边，Ω 再用力一顶，把球送回高处。
九个字跟着跳起来，一个接一个飞回自己那块拼图，转到贴合球面的角度，压平成印刷，啪地贴上。
字回齐了，球不再往下掉，轻轻一荡，停回原来的位置。顶上那几块缺口，还空着。
zh.summary: 维基百科不是哪一个人写成的，是千千万万说着不同语言的人一起托着。只要还有人愿意写，这颗球就掉不下来，也永远拼不完。

en.name: Wikipedia
idea: In 2001 Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger started Wikipedia, a free encyclopedia that anyone can edit. It is run by the non-profit Wikimedia Foundation, written entirely by volunteers in more than 300 languages, and kept going by readers' donations.

Its logo is a globe made of jigsaw pieces, each printed with a character from a different writing system: a Latin W, a Greek Omega, a Cyrillic I, the Chinese character 維 and more. A few pieces at the top are left out on purpose: the encyclopedia is never finished.
In the end, that globe is held up by its letters. So this film lets the letters step away for a moment, to see what happens to the globe.
beats: One by one, the nine letters on the front of the globe peel off, grow from a thin layer of print into solid black type, somersault through the air and land on the floor in two staggered rows.
Only a few small letters on the far edge are left, and the nearly bare white ball hangs in the air. It trembles, then drops.
The letters look up. W leaps and heads the ball, both of them squashing on impact; the Cyrillic I knocks it the other way, and Omega gives it one big push back up into the air.
The nine letters jump after it and fly home one by one to their own pieces, turning to sit flush with the curve of the globe, flattening back into print and pressing on with a snap.
With all the letters back, the globe stops falling, sways gently and settles where it started. The gap at the top is still open.
en.summary: No single person wrote Wikipedia. It is held up by countless people in countless languages, and as long as someone is still writing, the globe won't fall, and it will never quite be finished.

zh.name: Uber 优步
idea: Uber 2009 年在旧金山起步，最早叫 UberCab。流传最广的起点故事是 2008 年巴黎一个下雪的晚上：创始人在街头怎么也打不到车，于是想，要是按一下手机车就来了呢？2018 年改版以后，logo 只剩黑白两色的一个字标，用的是自家字体 Uber Move。Uber 这个词在德语里是“在……之上”。
打开过 Uber 的人都见过那张地图：从正上方看下去的街道，几辆黑色小车慢慢朝你开过来。那就让这四个黑色字母当一回那几辆车。
beats: 片子从标准 logo 开始。四个字母挂上倒挡，各自从车位里倒了出去。
镜头往上升，白底变成从正上方俯瞰的城市，楼房从地面一圈圈长出来。四个字母分头停在四个路口待命。
一个上车点从空中掉下来，弹了两下，地面荡开一圈波纹，旁边弹出一个黑色小方块：4 MIN。
四条黑色路线同时亮起来，从四个车位分别连到四个字母。
e 先从北边开下来，在前面的街上掉了个头；U 和 r 从左右两边拐进来；b 最后，从南边一路直上。转弯的时候字母跟着车头转，开过的路线一段段消失，倒计时跳成 3、2、1。
四个字母依次刹车，往前点一下头，稳稳停进各自的车位，又拼成了 Uber。
上车点收起来，楼房沉回地面，地图褪回白底，镜头落回正上方，停在标准 logo 上。
zh.summary: 按一下，车就来了。这件小事让很多人在陌生的街头、在下雨的深夜，不用再站在路边干等。

en.name: Uber
idea: Uber started in San Francisco in 2009, back when it was still called UberCab. The founding story people tell most often goes back to a snowy night in Paris in 2008: the founders couldn't get a cab, and the thought was simple. What if you could tap your phone and a car would just come? Since the 2018 redesign the logo has been a single black-and-white wordmark, set in the company's own typeface, Uber Move. In German, über means "above".
Anyone who has opened the app knows the view: streets seen from straight above, and a few little black cars making their way toward you. So here the four black letters get to be those cars.
beats: It opens on the standard logo. The four letters shift into reverse and back out of their spots.
The camera rises, the white page turns into a city seen from above, and buildings grow out of the ground in rings. The letters wait at four different corners.
A pickup pin drops from the sky, bounces twice and sends a ripple across the street. A small black tag pops up beside it: 4 MIN.
Four black routes light up at once, each one running from a parking spot out to a letter.

The e comes down from the north and swings a U-turn in the street. U and r turn in from either side, and b comes last, straight up from the south. Each letter turns with its nose through the corners, the route disappears behind it, and the countdown ticks to 3, 2, 1.
One by one the letters brake, dip forward and settle into their spots, spelling Uber again.
The pin folds away, the buildings sink back down, the map fades to white and the camera lands overhead on the standard logo.
en.summary: Tap, and a car comes. Such a small thing, and it meant a lot of people stopped standing at the curb in a strange city or on a rainy night, just waiting.
